readme:
## Parkour Alpine

It’s been two and a half years since our first map release. Since then, our maps have reached over 100,000 downloads, and we’ve been working hard on our new project. Now we’re excited to present **Parkour Alpine** — a casual and speedrun-friendly parkour map featuring three huge levels with increasing difficulty, from easy to challenging, so every player will find a challenge that suits them!

## Features

- Many known and loved mechanics as well as completely unique new ones

- Multiplayer-friendly

- Automatic checkpoints

- Cutscenes

- Easter eggs

- Boat racing

- Physics-based mechanics

- Light adventure map elements

- Shader-optimized level design

- Timers (ranking system coming soon)

- Reset functions for speedrunners

## Important Notes / Rules

- Minecraft version: **26.2**

- Gamemode: **Adventure Mode**

- The

/kill

 command is allowed if you get stuck.

- Checkpoints and spawnpoints are set automatically — do not set your own.

- The map is playable at any render distance (starting cutscene may lag on slower PCs).

- Have fun!

## Feedback

Since this map is freshly released, bugs may occur. If you encounter one, feel free to contact us via email at [Maps.Limbo@gmail.com](\"mailto:Maps.Limbo@gmail.com\") or join our Discord community:

[https://discord.gg/2UgpZ7hueH](\"https://discord.gg/2UgpZ7hueH\")

Our Discord is a place for community interaction, suggestions, and discussions about future projects. We hope to see you soon ;)

We can’t wait to hear your feedback and hope you enjoy your stay in the mountains of **Parkour Alpine**!

name: Crafty Cannoneers
description: 2 teams of pirates loot Treasure Chests, kill enemies and fire cannons in order to destroy the enemy ship!
readme:
Crafty Cannoneers is a game where 2 teams of Pirates are having a big battle, with their goal being to completely destroy the enemy team's ship as quickly as possible. They can do this by firing off a wide variety of Cannonballs using the Cannons found on their ships.

The island in the middle of the map is home to Treasure Chests! These Treasure Chests contain Gold, Gunpowder, special weapons and other kinds of loot. The Pirates must visit this island frequently in order to get enough resources to shoot their cannons.

Gold is used to purchase Cannonballs from the Pirate Traders on your ship and Gunpowder is used to shoot your Cannons.

Each Cannon has 2 Gunpowder slots on either side. You can insert up to 7 Gunpowder in these slots; the more Gunpowder you put in, the further the Cannonball will travel. You can even shoot Cannonballs in different directions by putting more Gunpowder in one slot than the other.

The ships also have Weakpoints, which deal critical damage when hit. The Pirates can expose these Weakpoints by spotting them with their Spotting Spyglass. If they want to hit these Weakpoints, they need to learn how to properly aim their Cannons.

Each ship has a Team Chest for all teammates to access shared resources. If an enemy makes it onto your ship, the Team Chest automatically locks itself, but if they have a Skeleton Key (found in Treasure Chests on the middle island), then they can unlock it and steal all of your precious items! You'll know when an enemy is on your ship if your Ship Bell starts ringing.

The last ship standing wins the game!

## Types of Cannonballs:

Cannonball: The most basic type of Cannonball. These deal the least amount of damage to ships, but are required to purchase the more special Cannonballs from your ship's Pirate Traders.

Tracer Cannonball: These are part of the default equipment of any Pirate. They deal no damage, you have an infinite amount of them, and firing them from a Cannon will cost you no Gunpowder. They will create a green trajectory line only apparent to their users, which means you can use them to find out where your shot will land.

Hot Cannonball: These Cannonballs set a ship on fire on impact, and set the Gunpowder slots of nearby Cannons on fire temporarily, rendering them useless for the enemy team. After a while, the fire will automatically extinguish, which will deal a bit of extra damage to ships as well. Combine these with Gas Cannonballs for an extra powerful explosion!

Gas Cannonball: A big cloud of toxic gas gets released from this Cannonball on impact, which gives any players inside it blindness, nausea, and poison while also removing any regeneration effects they may have had. Combine these with Hot Cannonballs for an extra powerful explosion!

Cannonball Cluster: Fire 5 Cannonballs for the price of 1! Cannonball Clusters are extremely inaccurate, especially on long range, but they are the best Cannonball to use against players on the central island due to their spread out range of effect.

Chain Cannonball: Two halves of a Cannonball, connected together by a chain. These are a little less accurate than other Cannonballs, and are best used when aimed at the sails of a ship. Hitting the sails with Chain Cannonballs will tear them apart and deal a lot of extra damage.

Bouncy Cannonball: After hitting their target, Bouncy Cannonballs will bounce around, blasting nearby players into the air and dealing damage to them with each bounce. They will randomly explode after bouncing around for a little bit.

Player Cannonball: A Cannonball shaped like a barrel; you can use these to launch yourself from a Cannon onto the enemy ship! It's not exactly subtle though: a Pirate shooting themselves out of a Cannon makes a very loud and distinct sound.

Golden Cannonball: These are only found in Skeleton Chests that occasionally spawn on the middle island throughout the game. Not only do they look really fancy, but they also give you extra Gold when you damage ships or kill players with them!

Copper Cannonball: Unlike regular Cannonballs, Copper Cannonballs lodge themselves into ships and repeatedly strike lightning to deoxidize the copper before exploding a second time. These are found exclusively when the Sea Storms modifier is enabled.

description: Jump your way through the space station, collecting all the cores from the drifting satellites, and return home before all is lost.
readme:
You wake up from cold sleep after an asteroid has collided with the space station.

You must hurry to traverse the station, collecting all the cores from the drifting satellites, and return home before everything is lost to the void of space.

---

Kuron Flux is a complex parkour map featuring 16 levels, each with its own mechanics, and increasing difficulty.

Estimated time: 2 hours

[Resource pack](https://github.com/Ctarron/Kuron-Flux/releases/latest/download/Kuron_Flux_RP.zip)

The last sections are way more complicated. If you get confused/stuck, here is a [full playthrough speedrun 1:07:18.](https://youtu.be/aCDKrB2uMFo)

## Features

- Multiplayer-Friendly (Although singleplayer is recommended)

- Many unique mechanics

- Automatic checkpoints

- Integrated timers, splits and quick restart for speedrunning

## Rules

- Gamemode: Adventure.

- No Mods: Play without performance mods, fullbright/gamma...

- This map uses core shaders. Playing with external shaders may cause issues and break the intended visuals.

- Resource Pack: Ensure the dedicated map resource pack is the only active one.

- No Cheating: Use the provided mechanics to progress.

## Recommended Settings

- Render Distance: 8–16 chunks (16 is recommended).

- Simulation Distance: 8–16 chunks.

- Entity Distance: 100% or higher.

- Darkness Pulsing: (for visibility).

- Improved Transparency: Must be ON.

- Biome Blend: Must be ON.

- Music & Sounds: Blocks [​ON]

- Music: This map features music from the Minecraft Creator-safe Playlist.

## Translations

- 🇺🇸 English

- 🇪🇸 Spanish

- 🇫🇷 French (by Leroidesafk)

- 🇰🇷 Korean (by TheOnlyMann)

- 🇯🇵 Japanese (by Tainoji)

- 🇨🇳 Chinese (by Ylong)

## Speedrun

Challenge yourself to improve on your best time.

Upload and share your run on [speedrun.com](https://www.speedrun.com/Kuron_Flux).

## Feedback

[Ctarron discord](https://discord.gg/EaYAnpsqyr) server for feedback/doubts.

readme:
### **PVP UNLIKE ANY OTHER**

Songs of Greavesoyl is a **character-based PvP game**, featuring multitude of memorable maps set across the grim world, various gamemodes for any number of players, and **over 70 unique playable characters**, each with their own stories to tell. Perfect for both casual and competetive play, Songs of Greavesoyl offers endless fun for you and your friends!

### **DIVERSE CAST OF CHARACTERS**

Play as a brave monster hunter, crazed mage, rogue assassin, silly musician, dragon tyrant, feral beasts, undead juggernaut, elemental of electricity, demon of ice, sea monster, living bio-weapon, lovecraftian gods and **many more**! Every character offers unique playstyle with their abilities, so pick your favorite one and slash, dash, shoot, fire, freeze, go invisible, traverse paralell worlds, pulverize, eviscerate and throw black holes at your enemies! On top of that, every character has their own story to tell - **they are actuall characters, not just nameless kits**.

### **MORE THAN A MINECRAFT MAP**

World of Greavesoyl has many stories to tell, not just those of playable cast. The setting made for [**Deep in Dungeon**](https://www.planetminecraft.com/project/w-i-p-deep-in-dungeon-1-11-2-roguelike-map-demo/) from 2017 was fleshed out into large dark fantasy universe with **deep lore covering over 3000 years of history**, and [**ongoing comic series**](https://tapas.io/mrkisiel23/series)!

### **MORE CONTENT TO COME**

The game was first published in december of 2020, and since then multiple major content updates were released, with new maps, gamemodes, characters and balance changes. It's not over yet - even more content will be added in the future to make Songs of Greavesoyl the **best it can possibly be**.

- Join our **discord server** to stay up to date on new content and community: [**https://discord.gg/2U5rxzNA6p**](https://discord.gg/2U5rxzNA6p)

- Check the wiki to learn more about the world and characters: [**https://greavesoyl.wiki.gg/**](https://greavesoyl.wiki.gg/)

- Read the comic series: [**https://tapas.io/mrkisiel23/series**](https://tapas.io/mrkisiel23/series)

**Rocket Riders** also features **7 new game modes** and **22 game modifiers **which bring new gameplay objectives and challenges to the table so the game always stays exciting!

The **Modification Room** in the center of the Lobby allows you to select active items, base decorations, game modifiers, game rules, and more, giving you the ability to fully customize your gameplay!

Rocket Riders has a set of **41 custom achievements!** See if you can earn them all along the way!

Story Overview

**:

An alien creature has been discovered walking amongst us, captured and studied by the great Doctor Maestro along with his team of elite scientists. You play as a "visitor" who was left and seemingly forgotten inside of the entry checkpoint room. Escape and follow along with the characters' stories and the aftermath of the events that occurred in the facility, solving your way through the security measures in place for unwanted eyes such as your own.

**

Game Mode:

**

Adventure

**

Average completion time:

**

~1-3 hours

There are several hint buttons throughout which are meant to be used if you can't figure out what to do. If you're still stuck or confused though, please reference the guide video in this post.

I spent roughly over a month (140+ active hours) making this map.

I'd love to hear what you think, so don't be afraid to leave a comment! Thank you so much for checking out my escape room! Enjoy!

readme:
# Ultimate Warrior: City of the Dead

The dead have risen... and the city is their kingdom.

**Ultimate Warrior: City of the Dead** is a massive Minecraft survival adventure inspired by classic round-based zombie gameplay, combining intense horde combat, exploration, quests, and a complete story-driven campaign into one action-packed experience.

Battle your way through a ruined city overrun by the undead as you find new areas, uncover hidden secrets, complete objectives, and piece together the mystery behind the apocalypse. Every round grows more dangerous as stronger hordes emerge from the darkness, testing your skill, strategy, and teamwork.

## Features

### 🧟 Story-Based Zombie Adventure

Experience a full quest-driven campaign that takes you across multiple locations throughout the City of the Dead. Find new areas, complete challenges, discover lore, and survive increasingly difficult waves of zombies as the story unfolds.

### ⚔️ Classic Round Survival

Fight endless waves of undead enemies in true zombie survival fashion. Earn resources, upgrade your equipment, and see how long you can survive against overwhelming odds.

### 🌆 Bonus Full-Size Survival Map: Aftermath

Included with the adventure is **Aftermath**, a large standalone zombie survival map designed purely for wave-based combat. Play solo or team up with friends to see how many rounds you can survive.

### 🏟️ Two Additional Mini Maps

Enjoy two extra mini maps, Laboratory and Hellfire built for fast-paced action.

### 👥 Singleplayer & Multiplayer Support

Play through the entire experience alone or with a group of friends. Whether you're tackling the story solo or surviving hordes together, the map is designed to support both styles of play. - Now updated to have a FULL multiplayer PVP mode independant of the main singleplayer / co-op experience! Pick from four new kits on FIVE new PVP maps and head to battle!

### 🎒 Multiple Starting Kits

Choose from a variety of kits and playstyles. Customize your approach to combat and find the setup that best matches your strategy.

### 🛠️ Zombie Map Creator System

Build your own zombie survival experiences using the included custom mapping system. Design arenas, create unique challenges, and fight endless hordes on maps of your own creation.

### 🔍 Secrets & Challenges

Explore every corner of the world to uncover hidden areas, Easter eggs, special rewards, and optional challenges designed for players who want to experience everything the map has to offer.

---

**Will you survive the hordes, uncover the truth behind the outbreak, and become the Ultimate Warrior?**

Gather your friends, sharpen your weapons, and prepare for the fight of your life.

**Welcome to the City of the Dead.** ☠️🧟‍♂️⚔️

readme:
# Escape the Basement

## Story

You wake up locked inside a massive basement.

The exit is nowhere to be found.

To escape, you'll need to explore every room, solve puzzles, unlock new areas, and uncover the path to freedom.

But be careful... not everything is what it seems.

Can you escape the basement?

---

## Features

- 🧩 Escape Room Gameplay

- 🔐 Solve unique puzzles

- 🔎 Search for hidden clues

- ⭐ 10 Hidden Collectibles

- ⏱️ Speedrun Challenge

- 🎮 Adventure Mode

- 👥 Singleplayer & Multiplayer Player Limit: None

---

## Rules

- Gamemode: Adventure

- Cheats: OFF

- Do not use commands.

- Break and place blocks only when the game allows it.

- Search every room carefully.

- Listen for sounds—they may be clues.

- If you get stuck, revisit previous rooms.

---

## Recommended Settings

- Particles: All

- Music: ON

- Sound: 80–100%

- Render Distance: 16+ Chunks

- Brightness: Moody (Recommended)

---

## Hidden Challenge

There are **10 hidden points** scattered throughout the basement.

Can you find them all?

### Final Score

- **0/10** — Did you even explore?

- **1–3/10** — A decent start.

- **4–6/10** — Nice work.

- **7–8/10** — Excellent explorer.

- **9/10** — So close...

- **10/10** — Perfect! Nothing escaped your eyes.

---

## Speedrun Challenge

- **Under 25:00** — 🏆 Legendary

- **25:00–35:00** — 🥇 Gold

- **35:00–45:00** — 🥈 Silver

- **45:00–60:00** — 🥉 Bronze

- **Over 60:00** — You escaped... eventually.

---

name: Locate Location
description: A location finding game with miniature location models.
readme:
All leaves are unique, so are minecraft locations. In this map, players try to find the location that looks exactly the same as the hint, a miniature location model. Multiple helpful tools including elytra are provided, so players can conveniently traverse the map, examine your hint anywhere, and submit your answer if you are in the right location. Don't worry about falling, players are totally invulnerable during the game. Explore and locate in any way you like!

### 25 Unique Levels

There are 25 pre-designed levels that guide players through the concept of the game. While each level utilizes some distinguishable blocks from structures, biomes or placed features to narrow down the search space, there are always other ways to locate the target.

### Randomly Generated Games

This map also provides random levels, a great choice to race against other players! Will the next level be from a cherry grove, a mangrove swamp, or even part of a village? Nobody knows! More tools are provided during random games, allowing players to reveal the target location when it is hard to locate, or head to next random terrain.

### Customize The Level

Players can customize many aspects of the game, including the sizes of map and the hint, limits of time and submission count. As a result, this map offers various game experiences from a fast locating race with small maps and detailed hints, to a thorough, block-to-block search with large maps and unlimited time.

description: A fun-filled snowball fight, perfect for the winter season!
readme:
Welcome to **Avalanche**, the official sequel to Snowy Skirmish! In this game, your objective is no longer to collect the most giftboxes or knock out the most enemies for points. The game is now more strategic and combat-oriented.

Knocking out enemy players will cause them to drop **Avalanche Rockets**. With these rockets, you can damage the mountains behind the enemy base, and if you do this enough times, you'll trigger an Avalanche.

Avalanches are the new way for you to score points, and the team to trigger the most Avalanches by the end of the game wins.

All powerups from Snowy Skirmish 1 have been reworked in terms of visuals and functionality. They now look and play better than ever before! We have also removed the 2-powerup per player restriction from Snowy Skirmish 1 in favor of item cooldowns.

Happy Holidays from the Zeronia Team!

Powerups:

- Ice Ball

: A strong ice ball with limited range, capable of knocking out enemies with a single hit.

- Hot Chocolate

: A consumable item; players can drink hot chocolate to quickly heal back some health, and knocked out players can use this to revive themselves.

- Snowman

: A friendly snowman that fires bursts of snowballs at enemy players that get near it. They can be destroyed with snow and ice balls, and they melt over time.

- Snowglobe

: Makes a stormy cloud where it lands. When enemies stand in its range, they'll get slowed down and take a lot of damage. When you stand in your own team's blizzards, you'll get snowballs much quicker.

- Icicle

: Melee weapon used to deal a lot of damage and knockback to enemy players.

- Healing Campfire

: A small campfire that heals nearby players. When knocked-out allies get near this, they'll be revived.

- Sleigh

: Lets you quickly move around the map, making you harder to hit. Press your jump key to perform a big jump while riding a Sleigh. Sleighs break over time when nobody is riding them or after a couple of big jumps.

- Coal Stocking

:

Similar to a flashbang. Blinds nearby players wherever it lands.

- Snow Barricade

:

Placeable block. Breaks upon impact with Snowballs, Iceballs, and Avalanche Rockets.

description: Gallery of biological cell scans and simulations by The Science and Technology Center for Quantitative Cell Biology
readme:
# About:

This world showcases various cells uploaded to Minecraft by The Science and Technology Center for Quantitative Cell Biology. Cells such as the yeast cell, the minimal bacteria cell (JCVI-syn3A), immortalized epithelial cells, and neutrophils are all included. Every cell is scientifically accurate, either directly scanned or generated from computer simulation data.

# Functionality Included:

## Learn about Cell Components:

- While visiting a cell, right click with the eye armor trim to get information about the cell component you are looking at.

## Listen to Narration:

- Turn on the setting for narration and click “Cell Tour” for a narrated tour through the cell and its various structures.

## Toggling Cell Components:

- Click on the iron pickaxe to open the UI to show or hide various cell structures

- Right click on the pickaxe again to return your hotbar to normal

- Use a book to toggle different cell components in settings

**NOTE:**

- Please wait for each iteration to complete before leaving the cell or attempting to toggle a new cell structure

- You may need to travel through the cell and load various chunks of the cell as they are being placed or removed.

## Travel Between Different Cells:

- Use the book to travel between different cells quickly

- Use the breeze rod to travel through walls without destroying them

Learn more about the CraftCells project here: DOI: [10.35459/tbp.2024.000275](https://www.doi.org/10.35459/tbp.2024.000275).

Visit our website: [https://qcb.illinois.edu/minecraft/](https://qcb.illinois.edu/minecraft/)

**[=-=-=-=-=-= Death Swap But Way Better =-=-=-=-=-=]**

[ 这款游戏支持中文游玩 / This map is available in Chinese! ]

**This map is for 26.1, NOT 1.21.11 unlike what it says above!!!**

Tired of the same old boring Minecraft Death Swap? We get it. That's why we decided to make Minecraft Death Swap... *Way Better.*

As usual, every few minutes, players swap positions with each other, and the idea is to build traps that'll take out your opponents right as you swap! Sounds like normal Death Swap, right?

Periodically, every 45 seconds, receive a choice of 3 different ridiculously powerful items, some of which may help you, while others will harm your opponents. Choose one of the three items by dropping it from your hotbar, and then just sit back and watch as the most chaotic Death Swap you've ever played unfolds right before you. Some items include spawning Oppenheimer's bomb, spawning the Warden, and directly teleporting someone to the Nether, amongst **an additional 100+ items!** Fight & outlast your way through a barrage of items in the most superior version of Minecraft Death Swap ever made!

name: Ketchup's Skyblock
description: A custom Skyblock map focusing on minimalism. Less materials and to work with, and only one island. Also includes a jukebox and some music discs :)
readme:
This is my very own custom Skyblock map! I wanted to make one for myself that included everything I would want in such a world. This map is meant to be substantially harder than a regular SkyBlock map, giving less materials to work with. Other SkyBlock maps are usually made with a normal world, carving a giant hole where the island is. This means you could technically reach natural generation if you travel far enough away from the orignal island. This world is completely empty, no natural generation anywhere! Other maps also usually have different types of biomes scattered around, this one doesn't. I don't know how to remove natural generation for the nether, so the world border has been used to prevent you from going far enough to see the natural generation. Don't worry, you still have plenty of space!

Every island and item is at or close to X=0 and Z=0 in both the overworld and the nether. I have tried to build the nether in a way that prevents any shenanigans with nether portals. There is no way to reach the end dimension, but I have made it empty as well in case you want to add a way to get there.

I'll list everything that is included, but you can play it yourself to find everything. There shouldn't be anything that you wouldn't find by yourself.

## This map includes:

A completely empty void (except for the islands) with only the default biome for all three dimensions

**Overworld:**

- A 3x3x3 dirt and grass island with a birch tree

- A jukebox

- A chest with 1x lava bucket

- The Plains biome

**The Nether:**

- A line of 4x obsidian to prevent destroying the island when spawning a portal

- A platform made of 4x warped nylium, 4x crimson nylium and 1x bone block

- A chest with Pigstep

- The Nether Wastes biome

Enjoy!

name: Plankland Wood Mansion
description: Welcome to Plankland Mansion, where simplicity meets grandeur, and every plank contributes to a masterpiece that truly feels like home..
readme:
Welcome to Plankland Mansion, a breathtaking wooden masterpiece that stands as a true symbol of creativity, patience, and architectural brilliance. Built entirely from planks, this magnificent Minecraft mansion captures the warmth and beauty of wood in every corner, creating a cozy yet luxurious atmosphere that immediately draws attention. From the moment you lay eyes on the exterior, the mansion impresses with its grand structure, symmetrical design, and glowing lights that highlight its intricate detailing, especially during the night.

As you approach the mansion, the carefully designed façade welcomes you with a sense of elegance and scale. The layered roofing, extended balconies, and large windows add depth and character to the build. The use of different wooden tones enhances the visual appeal, making the structure feel both natural and refined. The surrounding area complements the mansion beautifully, giving it the appearance of a peaceful retreat set in a calm and well-planned environment.

Stepping inside, you are greeted by a stunning entrance hall that sets the tone for the rest of the mansion. The flooring, often designed with patterns such as checkered layouts, immediately captures attention and adds a touch of sophistication. Warm lighting from lanterns and glow sources fills the space, creating a welcoming ambiance. The high ceilings and open layout make the entrance feel spacious and grand, giving visitors a sense of awe as they begin to explore further.

Moving deeper into the mansion, you will find a series of thoughtfully designed rooms, each with its own unique purpose and charm. The living areas are spacious and comfortable, featuring carefully arranged furniture that blends perfectly with the wooden theme. Sofas, tables, and decorative elements are placed in a way that makes the space feel lived-in and inviting. Large windows allow natural light to flood the interiors, enhancing the warm tones of the wood and creating a relaxing environment.

One of the highlights of Plankland Mansion is its beautifully crafted dining area. This space is designed to host gatherings and create memorable moments. A long dining table, surrounded by neatly arranged seating, sits at the center, while decorative lighting above adds elegance to the setting. The attention to detail in this room reflects the builder’s dedication to making the mansion not just visually appealing, but also functional and immersive.

The mansion also features a well-designed kitchen area that complements the dining space. With counters, storage sections, and aesthetic details, the kitchen blends practicality with style. Every element is carefully placed to maintain the wooden theme while ensuring the space feels realistic within the Minecraft world.

As you explore further, you will come across multiple bedrooms, each designed to provide comfort and privacy. These rooms are cozy yet stylish, with beds, lighting, and decorative features arranged harmoniously. The use of warm lighting and wood textures creates a peaceful atmosphere, making each bedroom feel like a perfect place to rest after a long day of adventure.

Another standout feature of Plankland Mansion is its grand staircase. This central element connects different levels of the mansion and adds a sense of luxury to the overall design. The staircase is wide and elegantly constructed, often serving as a focal point that enhances the mansion’s interior layout. It not only provides functionality but also contributes to the visual grandeur of the build.

The upper levels of the mansion continue to impress with additional rooms and open spaces. Balconies and corridors offer beautiful views of the surroundings, allowing players to appreciate the scale and beauty of the mansion from different perspectives. These areas also provide excellent vantage points, making the mansion both aesthetically pleasing and strategically useful in gameplay.

Lighting plays a crucial role throughout the mansion, and it has been used masterfully to enhance every space. The warm glow from lanterns and other light sources highlights the textures of the wood, creating a cozy and inviting atmosphere. At night, the mansion truly comes alive, glowing like a beacon and showcasing its intricate design against the darkness.

Beyond its beauty, Plankland Mansion is also best suited for survival gameplay. Its spacious layout allows for efficient organization of resources, dedicated storage areas, and comfortable living spaces. The secure structure, ample lighting, and well-planned interiors help protect against mobs while providing everything a player needs for long-term survival. Whether you are crafting, storing items, or simply relaxing after an adventure, this mansion offers both safety and functionality.

Attention to detail is evident in every part of Plankland Mansion. From the patterns on the floors to the placement of decorative blocks, everything has been carefully planned and executed. The interiors are not just functional but also visually engaging, encouraging exploration and admiration. Each room feels connected yet distinct, contributing to the overall harmony of the mansion.

In addition to its beauty, Plankland Mansion stands as a testament to dedication and effort. Building such a large and detailed structure entirely from planks requires time, planning, and creativity. The result is a build that not only looks impressive but also tells a story of persistence and passion for Minecraft building.

Overall, Plankland Mansion is more than just a house—it is a complete experience. It combines elegance, comfort, and creativity into one stunning structure that leaves a lasting impression on anyone who visits. Whether you are exploring its grand halls, relaxing in its cozy rooms, or simply admiring it from the outside, the mansion offers a sense of wonder and inspiration.

Welcome to Plankland Mansion, where simplicity meets grandeur, and every plank contributes to a masterpiece that truly feels like home..

description: Explore diverse environments and collect items for use on your next loops.
readme:
*You have been tasked by Magnus to test his newest invention, a time machine!*

*The experiment might end up having some complications though and the mess is yours to solve...*

## Gameplay

The map is in a loop and will get reset on death and upon finding special key items.

You can bring these key items with you to your next loops and access new areas you haven't been able to before or perhaps get a new perspective on an old area.

There's a skill-tree-like monument you select your items from and filling it is your goal...

## Multiplayer

The map supports multiplayer for an arbitrary amount of players (at least in theory), but multiplayer support was definitely an afterthought and the level design is not made with it in mind.

There are certain one-way places where you can't go back in singleplayer, but in multiplayer some players could stay behind. To fix this, upon trying to go through such places, a teleport request will be sent to all other players and you can only continue when all players are in the same place.

Some areas are also meant for singleplayer in the way that it's easier for one player to just take the lead, but the other players can still follow if they want to.

Also note that to mostly prevent weird issues with new players joining, the joining players will be teleported to a random already playing player. This should work 95% of the time, but it's still safest to only join when in the item selection area.

## Performance

This map uses a lot of tile entities for decoration which are really laggy in vanilla. I didn't realize this early enough due to using mods that fix this and if you don't do anything the map will be basically unplayable. There are two things you can do to fix this:

**A)** In the starting room of the map, there are signs about this exact topic and you can press one of them to remove all the laggy decoration from the map. This will off course degrade the visuals a bit, but in most areas it's honestly not the biggest difference.

**B)** You can also install mods to fix this. Either [Entity Culling](https://modrinth.com/mod/entityculling) or [Better Block Entities](https://modrinth.com/mod/better-block-entities) will deal with the issue. Just note that BBE will slightly alter the look of some blocks by adding shading to them. If you decide to install mods, I also recommend installing [Sodium](https://modrinth.com/mod/sodium), because it fixes a weird visual bug where blocks disappear for a frame on some teleports and also just generally improves performance.

The sequel to my highly rated map *Advancement Rush*, this map will test your knowledge of Minecraft advancements and your ability to execute under pressure. The goal is simple: use the resources within the rooms to obtain 30 advancements before time runs out. You have unlimited attempts to figure out which advancements you can get and to optimize a route.

For anyone who played the first map, this one is definitely harder. There are more rooms, more decorations, and, of course, more advancements. This one also uses some more complex mechanics, but nothing obscure or unfair. If you aren't familiar with Minecraft's advancements, you can always use the hints provided, and the Minecraft wiki is very useful too.

### - Features -

- 9 biome-themed rooms

- Multiple time limit options

- Revamped hint system

- Both a video and a text-based walkthrough

- Quieter music :)

### - IMPORTANT -

Because this map's route is longer than the first map, there are more chances to gain or lose time, which compound over the course of the run. This made it difficult for me to choose a time limit that will be fun for anyone of any skill level. I settled on 250 seconds by default, but you can select from a few different time limit options if you want. Please let me know in a comment if the default was too easy or too hard, I'd greatly appreciate the feedback!

description: A multiplayer horror map with asymmetrical gameplay. Choose your role: become a Survivor trying to escape the gloomy "ISO-9" complex or take control of the Animatronic whose goal is to destroy all living things. You'll find 3 unique escape routes, the ability to crawl, working surveillance cameras, cosmetics, and secret artifacts that manipulate time. Can you survive?
readme:
A multiplayer horror map with asymmetrical gameplay where every match tells a different story. Play as a **Survivor**, explore the mysterious **ISO-9 Research Complex**, solve objectives, and escape before it's too late—or become the **Animatronic**, a rogue experimental machine built to eliminate anyone still alive.

Designed for groups of friends, the map combines exploration, teamwork, strategy, and tense chases with fully custom mechanics, cinematic presentation, and replayable objectives.

## Welcome to the ISO-9 Complex

Something went terribly wrong inside the ISO-9 research facility. An experimental artificial intelligence controlling the security systems has gone rogue, locking down the entire complex and turning its prototype animatronic into the perfect predator.

As one of the remaining survivors, your only goal is to escape. Search abandoned laboratories, maintenance rooms, and underground corridors for supplies, repair critical systems, and uncover the secrets hidden throughout the facility.

## Two Unique Game Modes

### Escape

Work together with other survivors to restore power, collect key items, unlock restricted areas, and complete one of several unique escape routes before the Animatronic catches everyone.

### Hide & Seek

A faster, more action-focused mode where survivors must simply stay alive until the timer expires while avoiding the monster at all costs.

## Choose Your Role

### Survivor

Every survivor has access to a wide variety of tools and mechanics.

Search cabinets and lockers for valuable loot, repair generators, collect fuses and floppy disks, unlock safes, revive teammates with a defibrillator, use surveillance cameras to monitor dangerous areas, and hide beneath tables or inside ventilation shafts using the crawling mechanic.

Survival depends on teamwork, communication, and knowing when to run—or when to stay hidden.

### Animatronic

Become the hunter.

Track survivors using powerful abilities such as **Heart Echo**, **Noise Surge**, and **Bloody Rush**. Detect players through walls, create interference that disables security cameras, temporarily boost your speed, and prevent survivors from completing their objectives before they escape.

Every ability is designed to keep constant pressure on the survivors while rewarding aggressive and strategic play.

## Multiple Ways to Escape

No two matches have to end the same way.

Survivors can complete different objectives to unlock one of several escape routes, including repairing a helicopter, activating a mysterious portal, or using other hidden methods scattered throughout the complex. Each route requires different resources, teamwork, and planning.

## Custom Mechanics

The map features dozens of fully custom gameplay systems, including:

* Asymmetrical multiplayer gameplay

* Three unique escape routes

* Working surveillance cameras

* Crawling and hiding mechanics

* Player revival system

* Interactive puzzles and objectives

* Functional generators and electrical systems

* Secret artifacts with unique abilities

* Dynamic weather and atmosphere

* Multiple Animatronics in one match

* Cosmetic skins and unlockable accessories

* Fully animated models

* Custom HUD and interface

* Voice acting, ambient audio, story notes, and hidden easter eggs

## Equipment & Gadgets

Use a growing collection of unique items to survive.

Find tasers, medkits, smoke grenades, X-Ray scanners, magnets, physics guns, prototype artifacts, bananas that can make enemies slip, and many other tools that can completely change the outcome of a match.

Learning when—and how—to use each item is just as important as finding it.

## Built for Multiplayer

Whether you're cooperating as survivors or hunting your friends as the Animatronic, every round offers different strategies, random loot, changing objectives, and unpredictable encounters, making each playthrough feel fresh.

Can you escape the ISO-9 Complex... or will you become its next victim?

## About

The minimal bacteria cell (JCVI-syn3A) has the smallest genome of any living organism. This near-atomistic computer simulation of the minimal cell (2.5 Angstroms per block) shows the fine details of cell biology like never before. The rollercoaster ride takes you through the green plasma membrane studded with blue membrane proteins. You then ride along the glowstone DNA strand with its characteristic double helix shape and around the many red cytosolic proteins.

Learn more about CraftCells [here](https://qcb.illinois.edu/minecraft/). DOI: [10.35459/tbp.2024.000275](https://www.doi.org/10.35459/tbp.2024.000275).

1. WorldEdit ([https://modrinth.com/mod/worldedit](https://modrinth.com/mod/worldedit))

1. Move the files from

minecraft/saves/Bacteria_Cell_Rollercoaster/schematics

 to

minecraft/config/worldedit/schematics

1. Use the items from the chest to toggle on/off parts of the cell. Shift+right click to hide, right click to show.

readme:
⚠️ **WARNING: This map uses the latest mechanics and requires version 26.2 Snapshot 7 to work properly** (though it should run fine from 26.2 Snapshot 5 onwards). Playing on older versions will break the systems!

I proudly present my new production called **Hot Ping-Pong**! It is a crazy and dynamic minigame for two players or teams, where instead of a regular ball, you bounce a ticking Sulfur Cube filled with TNT.

The entire gameplay relies on reflexes and strategically hitting the explosive mob to the opponent's side using a special stick. The round continues until the cube blows someone up – you score a point by completely eliminating your opponent (or the enemy team). When that happens, the game automatically displays the score in the chat, and players are teleported back to the lobby, where you can safely reset the mechanism and start the next round.

Everything runs on a Command Block system that automatically counts points and has special fail-safes preventing cubes from escaping the map or the mechanism from jamming. Additionally, the map automatically forces Adventure Mode so nobody accidentally destroys the blue ice arena. The lobby itself is built in the atmosphere of an old, immersive PvP tavern with comfortable seats for spectators.

Download the map, invite your friends, and see who handles the pressure of running out of time the best!

*PS: The entire map contains 43 Command Blocks.*

name: Lock In
description: A minecraft board game where you choose items to use in unusual ways!
readme:
# PREMISE:

In LOCK IN, your goal is to get to the end the fastest. That's it!

Every round, you'll be scored by your fellow players. At the end of the round, the player with the most votes moves the furthest, and so on. It's quite simple.

## ROUNDS:

At the start of each ROUND, players will be teleported to the stage, which will be transformed into a random location (kitchen, laboratory, jungle, etc...)

Somewhere on the stage will be a chest with 27 random items. Each player must take three items out of the chest that they think may be helpful for that specific location. Once a player has three items in their inventory, their choices are Locked In. Once every player has Locked In, the round will progress.

## PROMPTS:

One player will be randomly selected to go first, and the prompt will be revealed. A prompt will look something like this:

*"You’re pitching a new item to the CEO of McDonalds. Please describe a fast food combo meal you’d make using your three items."*

The active player will have some time (default one minute) to answer the prompt to the best of their ability. Their goal is to impress the other three players, who are on the judging platform. Once time is up, the active player becomes a judge. One of the judges becomes the new active player, and the timer starts again! Everyone gets the same prompt.

As a rule of thumb, play to your audience! If you think your friends will score higher based on what's most funny, go nuts with it! If you're trying to go for realism, change up your strategy! This is your chance to improvise, so let hilarity ensue.

# REQUIREMENTS

- Four players. No more, no less, and all in a voice call or equivalent.

- Minecraft java edition version 26.2

- The map's built-in resourcepack, which can be extracted and used as a server resourcepack if needed.

name: DJC City
description: Version 9.0 - Large and detailed city built by hand.
readme:
**

About DJC City

**

Welcome to the city of ambitions, built by just two main builders over the course of 2+ years. We've been working very hard to produce an excellent world for you to do whatever you want with. Take a look at our huge hand-terraformed map ready to be filled in, or walk around the bustling streets of the city! We've got it all; ranging from thriving business districts to quiet suburban houses, large freeways and interconnected road networks. We've also got plenty of secrets, ranging from little compartments in buildings, to entire secret tunnel systems and much more, including a vast story of the city and much lore to find!

**

Our History

**

DJC City was initially begun by just two friends, Cyeban and badboy_cj. Our other good friend thedonhand joined in too as well as small visits and little help by other friends and builders, but I can say that 99% of everything in this city was made by just the two of us! Did you know, this wasn't actually supposed to turn out as a city? We initially just felt like making a company headquarters for our new company "DJC Inc", so I booted up a server, and we found a random slab of rock to get working on! From there, we decided to make another building next to it, "Peckria Tower", and then another. Soon enough, more buildings were being built, road networks were being established and city plazas were made! By then, we were fully committed to the city, and decided to start thinking of long-term expansion and terraforming. This city was built in a mesa biome, not the greatest for terrain and especially since we didn't do any prior terraforming to the city, we largely improvised the waterfronts, terrain shapes and layout of the buildings. I believe this is what makes the city so unique, as it almost represents a real-life factor of starting in the middle of nowhere and making it work.

**

Some key features

**

From mostly functional casinos to post offices with real news stories, we've got it all for an immersive experience! We've made the city at a smaller scale than some cities, but I believe this helps keep a minecraft-scaled city, making you feel like you are living in the city and aren't an ant. Need to travel between suburbs? Use our highways, freeways or state routes, all packed with fully informational guidance signs to find your point B! Want to roleplay a city or suburban lifestyle? You've found the right place! With every building fully decorated, you can visit the doctors, go to work, go shopping or simply sleep in a random house! We've not only got our own brands, but shops and supermarkets are fully equipped with custom products!

**

CBD Island

**

Our first and oldest suburb, the center of the city! Featuring the oldest buildings and areas you can find in the whole city, the grand parliament, Peckria Plaza, a functional underground metro line and much more.

**

Jerryden

**

The second ever finished suburb, and the center of tourism. Featuring a central train station, a grand casino and hotel building featuring over 100 rooms, the beautiful beach, a bustling tourist and leisure district, the biggest shopping centre of the city and much more. This is the ultimate holiday and tourism destination!

**

Alburn

**

This is where suburbanization begins, with many fully furnished houses, shopping strips, a stunning cathedral, the biggest hospital of the city and more. You can live very nicely here, with beautiful views of the ocean and CBD Island, as well as easy connections to both major freeways and a highway. This suburb provides an excellent day-to-day lifestyle.

**

Jimmy Caperoni International Airport

**

Travel anywhere you need to go with this bustling airport featuring multiple gates, fully decorated duty free shops, a hotel for long layovers, custom signage and more importantly, a fully roleplay-ready check-in and flying experience! The airplanes were hand-made and fully decorated, providing details as small as seat numbers and folding tray tables!

*Those are just some of the many planned suburbs and areas of the city, and as it slowly expands it's worth being part of our journey. Join our discord server for all updates, information, documentation and help!*

[**https://discord.gg/asWCeuVWt8**](https://discord.gg/asWCeuVWt8)[** **](https://discord.gg/asWCeuVWt8)

**

Frequently asked questions

**

**Q: **

Is this city actually over 2 years old?

**A: **

It's been getting built over the last 2 years, but not continuously. I've been taking small breaks, and since it is just a passion project I do not put my full time into it.

**Q: **

What game version does the city use?

**A: **

It uses 1.21.8 so far, and any version below may break the game as we use blocks from 1.21.8.

**Q: **

Is this city family friendly?

**A: **

I would say it's family friendly to a point, it does contain some swearing and controversial remarks in select parts. I would generally say it's mild enough not to worry about, but I wouldn't recommend downloading if you are below the age of 15.

**Q: **

Can I use this map in a video or reupload it?

**A: **

You can use it in videos, or post it all over social media as long as you provide credit. Please provide the link to this download page if you do post it anywhere, and make sure to credit Cyeban and badboy_cj. As for reuploading in onto other map websites, please don't.

**Q: **

Did you use any world editing applications?

**A: **

As mentioned in the history section, No. I began using worldedit to help flatten land and only fill in square sections of wall or flooring, but thats it. 90% of the building and terraforming was done by hand.

readme:
This is an adventure map with some parkour that is based off the Super Mario Galaxy games. Actually, it is a full on recreation/replica!

## Background Information

I have decided to finish this Minecraft map that I posted a while ago and include **every mission** (except prankster comments and Luigi missions). There are now a total of **101 stars** to collect!

This is basically **Hogwarts007's** and **99blockmaking's** map, but they let me build the rest of the galaxies. Their old map was about 20% complete. The timeline of this map can be seen below:

- **2015** – Map creators Hogwarts007 and 99blockmaking published their last version of the map.

- **2018** – I stepped in and built every galaxy, but not every mission.

- **2021** – I decided to build every main mission, including new planets, for a total of 86 stars.

- **2024** – I returned to make some minor improvements and fixes.

- **2025** – I added 1 galaxy from each world from Super Mario Galaxy 2, bringing the total stars to 101.

## Map Information

You can play with up to 3 players! Traverse across the blocky galaxies in this recreation of Super Mario Galaxy. There will be mobs to slay, stars to collect, bosses to fight, and parkour to conquer. Collect all 101 stars to win the map!

When you start the map, you'll begin in the gate area. After collecting your first grand star, you’ll head to the comet observatory.

Shout out to **Leihcbone** — a true inspiration. Please check out everyone involved!

If you're a YouTuber and want to create a series based on this map, go ahead! I’d love to see your videos. Please send me the link if you do!

**Note:** Make sure to play this map on versions **1.21.5 to 1.21.10. **Anything after that will break the map because Minecraft keeps changing their commands. I recommend playing on 1.21.5. If the map breaks, let me know! If you're stuck, you can teleport to the comet observatory at coordinates:

Passages realign and entire chambers reconfigure when you least expect it. Your memory and perception will be tested as you solve intricate puzzles in an environment that refuses to stay still. Can you find the logic in the chaos and escape?

## Minecraft Party 2

Minecraft Party 2 is a 2–10 player game loosely based on Mario Party. This game features over 100 minigames, including:

- 35 Free-For-All Minigames

- 14 2v2 Minigames

- 14 1v3 Minigames

- 9 Battle Minigames

- 7 Coin Minigames

- 14 Duel Minigames

- 8 Micro Duel Minigames

Minecraft Party 2 also includes 30+ usable items (each with an enhanced pair) and 16 unique boards to play on.

**Estimated Gameplay Time:** ~2 hours (varies by settings)

**Players:** 2–10 (even number recommended, spectators allowed)

---

## Basic Gameplay

The main objective is to earn the greatest number of stars. Ties are broken by coin count. Stars are purchased with coins when passing the Star Seller, who relocates after each purchase.

Players roll a dice (1–10) to move across board spaces, each triggering different effects such as:

- Gaining or losing coins

- Random events

- Duels or battle minigames

- Items, traps, or Chance Time

Coins can be used to buy stars or items. Bonus stars are awarded for achievements like winning minigames or triggering events.

---

## Game Modes

### Quick Play

Play any minigame freely. No scores are kept. Teams can be set manually or randomized.

### Turn Mode

Play for a fixed number of turns. Bonus stars are awarded at the end. A special event occurs during the final five turns.

### Star Race Mode

The first player to reach the target number of stars wins. Bonus stars update live and cannot be shared.

### Grand Prix Mode

Back-to-back minigames only. No boards or stars. Earn coins based on placement. The player with the most coins wins.

### Doubles Mode

Two teams of two players. Coins and stars are shared. Playable in Turn or Star Race modes.

### Mega Party

Up to 10 players. Supports teams, pairs, or solo play. Coin distribution is rebalanced.

### Mini Party

Designed for 2–3 players. 1v3 minigames are disabled.

---

## Boards

###

Center Park

An urban park board with dynamic intersections, traffic control mechanics, and two star sellers. Custom bonus: **Ticket Star**.

###

Airborne Isles

Quest-based board with teleporters and strategic traversal. Bonus star goes to the player with the most completed laps.

###

Port Town

Classic-style board with shops, cannons, and ship theft. Bonus star: **Coin Thief Star**.

###

Lost City

Day/night cycle board with variable star prices. Designed for fast star acquisition.

###

Largest board with pellets, warps, and power-ups. Bonus star: **Pellet Star**.

---

## Minigames

Minigames are color-coded by type:

Free-for-all

,

2v2

,

1v3

,

Battle

,

Coin

,

Duel

,

Micro Duel

Dropper:

 Fall through randomly generated rings.

Monster Shoot:

 Shoot falling monsters for points.

Cave Parkour:

 Navigate randomized cave paths.

---

## Special Events

One special event occurs per game. The last-place player chooses between two random events.

Special events trigger during the final five turns or near the end of Star Race mode.

---

## Updating Minecraft Party 2 (Server Hosts)

1. Store stats books in your inventory.

1. Copy level.dat, playerdata, scoreboard.dat, and advancements.

1. Paste into the new world folder.

1. Place stats books in the hub chest.

---

## Settings

- 2–10 players (spectators allowed)

- At least one operator recommended

- Minecraft 1.21.7 or 1.21.8

- Render distance: 8+ chunks

- Do not use Lunar Client or Paper

---

## Important Notes

- Pause only at the start of a turn

- Structure Void (X) can cancel minigames

- Operators can skip turns or cancel games

- Player swapping supported via command

---

## Languages

- English (default)

- Pirate Speak

- Russian

- Chinese

- Japanese

---

readme:
# Best Minecraft Player Of All Time

Play as our favorite astrophysicist and YouTuber, [**About Oliver**](https://youtube.com/@AboutOliver), known for his fully blind no-wiki Minecraft series, and embark on an unforgettable journey with his friend Stuart on a mysterious vacation island, where Oliver is about to receive the prestigious award for the ***Best Minecraft Player Of All Time***.

![](https://cdn.zptr.cc/f/yxsd74rvxex0d3miqftgdbq3/bmpoat_features.png)

Sounds simple enough… right? What could possibly go wrong?

Yeah, there is a fun theme park and cozy lookouts, but, as the vacation unfolds, things start to feel a little off. Mysteries emerge, danger lurks around every corner, and what was supposed to be a celebration, slowly turns into something far bigger than expected. With nearly 8 hours of gameplay packed with humor, tension, scares, fresh challenges, and cinematic cutscenes, this adventure keeps surprising you until the very end.

![](https://cdn.zptr.cc/f/ait4ckibiadzlzq-gm47qwgx/bmpoat_footer.png)

In the words of everyone who has already played it, including Oliver himself, this map feels like a full standalone game. You'll experience a wide variety of gameplay styles, some innovative and original, others lovingly nostalgic, all blended together in a natural and organic way. You'll laugh at the jokes even if you don't know About Oliver, you'll get genuinely scared, and you'll uncover a captivating and unexpected story.

Oh, did I mention this map features a full original soundtrack composed exclusively for it? All 60+ tracks were professionally made by members of our team, tailored to enhance the experience. Trust us, your ears are in for a treat.

So join Stuart, step onto the island, and get ready to officially become the **BMPOAT**.

**Content Notice**

Includes mild horror themes, brief references to violence/torture, light blood/gore effects, and some mature jokes. Nothing really explicit is shown, but player discretion is advised. A family friendly version of the map that gets rid of that is in the works!

## Installation & Requirements

**The map works ONLY on 1.21.10 in Singleplayer-mode.**

The zip file contains both the world save and a shader settings file. Make sure to extract the world save and place it inside your saves folder.

The intended experience for this map is using the [**Complementary Reimagined**](https://modrinth.com/shader/complementary-reimagined) shaders with the provided shader settings. The settings file can be imported in the Shader Pack Settings menu in-game.

This map requires a decent PC to play. If you have an older pc it is still playable, but you could experience slight slowdowns and music desyncs. We recommend playing the map with [Sodium](https://modrinth.com/mod/sodium), [Lithium](https://modrinth.com/mod/lithium) and [Entity Culling](https://modrinth.com/mod/entityculling) for best performance.

**Commands For Speedrunners**

/function map:stop

Stops the map and teleports you back to the starting lobby.

/scoreboard objectives setdisplay sidebar Speedrun

Shows a timer that automatically starts and stops counting at the right moments.

/scoreboard objectives setdisplay sidebar

Hides the timer.

The full original soundtrack of the map can be listened to [here](https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PL29pUvwSoFuZ3EPrIRKKRDYPKJ-8UumR3).

Welcome to Dollar Store Hypixel! Here you can play 5 minigames that I've built that are also on Hypixel. Now, why would you want to play on this map? Well let's say one of your friends is banned from Hypixel and you wanted to play together. You can do so right here! Also let's say that you want to play on Hypixel with your friends, but you can't create a private party because you have to be MVP++ and you have to pay for that. This map is the perfect opportunity to play with your friends!

The number of players this map can be played with sort of depends on the minigames. In general, the number of players should be about 2-4, which 4 players is highly recommended for the most fun.

- BedWars (4 players max) (4 maps)
- Build Battle (8 players max) (24 building rooms)
- Murder Mystery (13 players max) (3 maps)
- TNT Run (4 players max) (4 maps)

Make sure to read all of the information for each minigame, and all of the rules for each minigame as well!

If something goes wrong, please leave a comment so I can potentially fix the issue.

If you get lost or something, just know that the coordinates to the main area are 960 -59 -601.

Note: This map might be better to play in a realm than on some free server hosting site, but I'm not sure. Play either way, but I highly recommend a realm.

If you're a YouTuber and you want to play my map, send me a link to your video because I would love to see it! Also maybe put "Dollar Store Hypixel" somewhere in your video so that I can find it.

Play this map on 1.21.5 to 1.21.10 because I'm pretty sure other versions will break it since every time Minecraft updates, they always somehow change the command format for certain stuff and it's annoying. I highly recommend playing on 1.21.5 as I see it as the best version to play it on.

readme:
**EDENPATH** is a singleplayer roguelite adventure with roughly 5-8 hours of gameplay. It features 3 dungeons, a custom soundtrack, and over 100 custom items.

### Face the EDENPATH

Be the first person in recorded history to survive an apocalypse and retreat to Earth's final safe haven. The way there is guarded by haunted mines, a ruined subterranean kingdom, and a forgotten and forlorn cult that has lost its way.

### Die, Come Back, Die Again

Upon failure, you are resurrected with experience in the form of POINTS. Spend POINTS on permanent buffs, gear upgrades, and more. Use the training room to practice and understand discovered items, and take advantage of unique challenge modifiers that give bonus points to good performances.

### Loot and Conquer

The dungeon never remains the same between lives. Countless rooms with hidden chests and moving doorways make each run different. Race the clock as enemies scale and strengthen with time, finding weapons, armor, and consumables to stave off the inevitable. Outlast the onslaught to face the dungeons guardian.

Edenpath is meant to be played in singleplayer, and is best experienced with the custom soundtrack that comes with the .zip file, made by Minecraft user bladeejamin.

description: Can you spot the hidden Shulker Box? Test your eyes across 8 uniquely themed, mob-free rooms in this classic, fast-paced puzzle map!
readme:
## The 8 Biomes & Dimensions

You will have to search through 8 uniquely themed, highly detailed rooms:

- **Plains** – A peaceful, green start... or is it?

- **Desert** – Watch your step among the sand and cactus.

- **Snowy** – A freezing landscape where secrets hide in the ice.

- **Cave** – Dark, narrow, and full of rocky hiding spots.

- **Bastion** – Piglin territory, minus the Piglins. Look closely at the blackstone.

- **Fortress** – Netherrack and bricks. Don't let the red haze distract you.

- **Ender Dragon** – The main island of the End. The truth is out there.

- **End City** – The final challenge among chests and purpur blocks.

## Map Features & Rules

- **Zero Entities:** No mobs, no jumpscares, no stress. Just you and the environment.

- **Pure Search:** Focus on exploration and spotting the hidden Shulker Box.

- **Players:** Singleplayer is recommended, but the map is multiplayer friendly.

**Tip:** Look everywhere — behind blocks, under lava, and high up in the ceiling. The Shulker Box could be disguised anywhere.

description: Recreation of Whomp's Fortress from the 1996 game Super Mario 64
readme:
This is a recreation of Super Mario 64's Whomp's Fortress level, complete with details such as: bamboo and mangrove buttons for yellow and red coins, recreations of Whomps, Thwomps, Bomps, and the Whomp King, and green candles where 1-Ups would typically spawn.

The map contains 100% vanilla blocks, which led to some design considerations that may appear off, such as blocks used for certain palettes.

The only feature I have added that does not exist in the original level is some clouds underneath the structure I added for visuals.

The geometry and block palettes of the island were created using Axiom version 5.1.1 for Minecraft 1.20.1, then the build was exported and migrated to 1.21.10 NeoForge.

The reason I chose to migrate it to NeoForge was that I plan to use this build in a mod that recreates not just Whomp's Fortress island, but also adds true functionality for red coins, stars, and custom enemies, such as the Thwomps and Whomps.

You can view the mod's progress (when I publish it) on the GitHub page linked in my profile.

readme:
Panoris High: Reborn is a re-imaging of the original Panoris High. Which is a 2.5 hour long atmospheric and story-driven horror story map. Reworking the story, updating visuals and adding a brand new ending.

**Story so far:**

Skyler is a 15 year old student from Newlan High. Her school went on an abroad trip just before the summer holidays kicked in. This trip was planned so that all students can enjoy a holiday in case her family couldn't afford something like it. While visiting some of the nearby ruins Skyler decided to walk around the nearby forest. After walking around for a while a heavy storm started to form and the skies also turned dark and it started to become night. While trying to find a place to shelter for the storm. Skyler came across an abandoned school known as Panoris High.

Panoris high used to be a well known and popular school around those parts back in the day. However after a series of tragic events the school was left behind to rot within the depths of the forest. While sheltering within the school for the storm, you will likely find out what exactly those tragic events were and what other reasons might have lead to the school closing her doors for good. But would those discoveries lead to clarifications? Or was it better off to have left the stories alone, undiscovered in the history books.

**About the map:**

Panoris High is an 2.5 hour long atmospheric and story-driven map. It is also the first map in the ongoing Panoris series. In celebration of the original map's 5 years anniversary. A new version has been released which has reworked the entire story of the original map. So that the story makes more sense in combination to the other parts in the series. Beside that a brand new ending has been added which makes the total endings 4. A bad, neutral, good and true ending.

**Features:**

- A long and completely reworked story (old players will also experience a new story).

- A custom resource pack with 3d models and fitting tracks.

- A large school ready for you to be explored.

- Collectables.

- 4 endings.

**Preferred settings & rules:**

- Put the brightness between 50% and 100%

- Put the render distance between 10 and 16

- Turn smooth lightning off

- All sounds beside music up to 100% (if it is too loud feel free to lower it though)

- No cheating

**Final notes:**

Even though it is a story-driven horror map it still contains a few jumpscares so be aware of that. Multiplayer is supported but it was originally made for single player so it can contain some bugs if you play it with multiple people.

Also if you would like updates on my future maps make sure to check my youtube channel's post tab. I post updates most often there:

[https://www.youtube.com/@Fallen__Project/posts](https://www.youtube.com/@Fallen__Project/posts)

readme:
Three years ago a school called Panoris High closed down for good after an event that is called the second tragedy within the local community and by the former students of the high school.

**Story so far:**

Three years ago a school called Panoris High closed down for good after a event that is called the second tragedy within the local community and by the former students of the high school. Kate who used to attend panoris high in it's glory days have been going to the trauma clinic after since she left the school. She left Panoris High during what was called the first tragedy. Where all of her classmates mysteriously died with only her being left as the lone survivor of those mysterious crimes from what she beliefs. However she decides to face her fears and revisit the school that still haunts her until this very day. To find out what the reason of all those deaths were and she has faith to possibly find other survivors if there are any left.

**About the map:**

Panoris Origins: Kate's Story is the first episode of a three-episodic map called Panoris Origins. Panoris Origins: Kate's Story is a psychological horror map that I have been working on for the past half year. It being a psychological horror map means that I have put most of my focus in the atmosphere of the school & story and characters. It is also a prequel to all previous panoris maps so new players can play it if they wish cause the story is stand-alone.

**Features:**

- A rich story

- Plenty of scenes

- 3d models

- A big school ready to be explored

- Extra lore spread around the school in books

- Multiple endings

**Preferred Settings & Rules:**

- 1. Put Brightness between 25% and 50%. If you can't see anything your allowed to put it higher.

- 2. Put the Render Distance between 8 and 12

- 3. Smooth lighting has to be turned off

- 4. Put all sounds beside music on 100%

- 5. No cheating

- 6. No use of mods beside optifine & shaders.

**Final notes:**

- 1. It is a single-player only. So it won't work if you try to play it on multiplayer.

- 2. It takes 20 - 30 minutes

- 3. It is made in 1.16.5 so please play it on this version. Otherwise the commands might not work.

- 4. It contains a few jumpscares

Lastly here is a guide if your stuck within the map(Spoilers ahead):

Main Hall(after entering Panoris) - > Room A-1 - > Room A-2 - > Room A-4 - > Computer Room - > TV Room -> Changing Rooms -> Biology Room (entrance to the hall is at the start of Hall 1-2) -> Library (All the way at the start of the building where the rumble of stone is) - > Dorms (You can get there by going through the door at the gym) -> Room 10 (At Hall 1-1) - > Just keep walking straight through the doors after the cutscenes

Also if you would like updates on my future maps make sure to check my youtube channel's post tab. I post updates most often there:

readme:
Welcome to Bayville, the most realistic town in Minecraft! This map works without mods, you only have to enable the **Bayville Resource Pack**, which is included in the download file.

Bayville is a perfect map for roleplay and life simulation. It has many unique features such as working **cars, trains, buses, NPCs** and also a **realistic economy system**. Gain experience by **attending school classes** and unlock new and better-paying jobs. Become a **waiter**, **pizza maker**, **firefighter**, **train driver**,** veterinarian**,... Do jobs to earn **emeralds**, the currency of the map. Many different stores, coffeeshops and restaurants allow you to buy everything you need (food, clothes, furnitures and even houses).

When you play the world for the first time, you will get a short **introduction **and some basic items such as a **clock**, which shows you the current in-game time. Please also read the **Town Guide Book** to get some useful information about the town.

Besides Bayville, there are many other places on the map to explore. Take the **train **or ride a **bicycle **to reach new places. Or buy your own **car **and take a road trip! You can also **go skiing**, watch a **movie **in the cinema, play **soccer **or relax at the **beach**. There are many things to explore. If you have any issues or suggestions, please let me know in the comments!

*

Note: This map works on Java Edition 1.21.11 - 26.2

description: Escape room adventure taking you through a wide variety of environments and puzzles.
readme:
Dive into Montero, a single player escape room with a wide variety of moderately challenging puzzles and environments.

I made this escape room in 2021, and now that I understand how to convert my realm servers into single player maps, I thought I'd release it to the public.

## RULES:

1) **NO DIGGING OR BREAKING OBJECTS**. The puzzles were designed to be beaten without the need to break anything. And obviously if you dig through the walls, you can escape with too much ease which would ruin the fun.

2) **REMOVE ALL ITEMS AND GEAR BEFORE STARTING.** The puzzles were designed to be beaten with a specific number of items in your inventory to use, so having any at the beginning would be cheating.

That's it! The escape room takes an average of ~1 hour to complete depending on your skill and knowledge of the game mechanics.

If you're stuck or confused, feel free to reference the guide video that I will be posting here.

Enjoy the escape room , and feel free to leave a comment! I'm excited to see what you all think.

-Dexpa

readme:
Up to four teams compete and race to beat Minecraft as fast as possible! All four teams will have their own identical map with the resources required to beat the game and win; there are 7 unique maps to choose from!

Four teams will compete and race to beat Minecraft as fast as possible! All four teams will have their own identical overworld-nether, which has everything they need to beat Minecraft; however, all teams share an end island. readme:
## Available in Vanilla Minecraft Java Edition Version:

**1.21.11**

Welcome to

**Undead Underneath**

, our latest (and hopefully greatest) Zombie Survival Minecraft map, created 3 years after its predecessor, [

Kein Entkommen

](https://www.curseforge.com/linkout?remoteUrl=https%253a%252f%252fwww.planetminecraft.com%252fproject%252fkein-entkommen-open-beta%252f)

.

 Battle hordes of the undead as you navigate, stumble, and take advantage of carefully crafted environments, upgrading your gear from a humble wooden sword to your desired loadout.

As you progress, you will come to find that zombies will begin to brandish weapons, equip armor, and possess unique abilities of their own that have the potential to shift the tides of battle. Still, it would be in your best interest not to let this unrelenting force overwhelm you; gear up with friends or go in alone and be ready to conquer this undying threat at any cost!

##

Experience

- An **immersive point-based system**, where slaying zombies earns you points.

- An **engaging combo system** that repairs your gear based on your kill amount.

- **Hordes of undead enemies** that will progressively **grow in challenge as you play.**

- Experimentation and synergy, choosing from **100+ unique weapons and gear.**

- **Numerous perks**, each of which can be upgraded to amplify their effects.

- Customization, as you **tailor your gear to your liking** with upgrade stations.

- **Diverse environments**, each with distinct dangers and unique advantages.

- Strategy through **using many traps** found throughout the map!

- Luck of the draw with our improvement on Effect Amplifiers from years past - **The Shrine.**

- **Selectable difficulty levels**, letting you decide your preferred level of play.

- **A thorough easter egg**, ultimately facing off against a formidable final boss!

- Cooperation, with **4 player support.**

- All of the above **+ so much more!**

Thank you, regardless of whether you are simply browsing the download page or would like to try the map. This map itself has taken us several years to develop; we hope every piece of it shows!

readme:
## Map Introduction:

Based on real events

This is a psychological horror story-driven map played from a first-person perspective. The story is adapted from a shocking deep-sea fishing vessel incident that shook the world. All character names, ship names, and place names have been anonymized.

You play as "Xiao Ma", an ordinary young crew member who boards the deep-sea fishing vessel "Yu'anshun" with the hope of earning enough money for the bride price and returning home to marry his girlfriend. However, contract fraud, monotonous labor, oppression from management… discontent spreads rapidly among the crew. After a bloody ship hijacking, you are forced into an isolated drift of murder.

Game Version: 1.21.11

Built-in resource pack with music and sound effects – headphone use is recommended.

Recommended: Play with Iris shaders for better visuals.

Playtime: Approximately 40 minutes.Single-player only.

Multi-language support: Simplified Chinese(zh_cn), Traditional Chinese(zh_tw)(zh_hk), English(en_us), Japanese(ja_jp), Korean(ko_kr).

To change the language, simply switch the in-game language before entering the map.

name: ColorMix Parkour
description: A parkour map where you control which blocks appear by holding corresponding colored items
readme:
**ColorMix Parkour **is a tricky 8-stage parkour map where you control which blocks you can stand on by holding corresponding colored items. Later stages require secondary colors, which are activated by holding two primary colors in each hand. The parkour itself isn't too difficult - the challenge is being able to swap and mix colors mid-air to cross each stage.

### - IMPORTANT -

This map relies HEAVILY on swapping slots in your hotbar and offhand while jumping. Make sure you can **scroll** and have an easily accessible **offhand keybind**. Using hotbar keybinds instead of scrolling is possible but much more difficult due to having to switch items while parkouring.

### - Map Info -

- Players: Singleplayer only

- Difficulty: Definitely not easy, but not impossible either. The concept takes some time getting used to, and the last couple stages really push it to its limit.

- Playtime: Expect at least an hour for a casual player.

- Version: 1.21.11

- Mods/Shaders: No known incompatibilities

### - Credits -

Only myself. If you have questions/feedback, I am available on Discord @CharredButter, or you can just leave a comment on the map page.
