readme:
**Newlan High: Reborn is a revised and updated version of the original **[**Newlan High.**](https://www.minecraftmaps.com/37344-panoris-newlan-high)

**Dialogues have been reworked to be more lore-accurate to the rest of the Panoris High series. While also improving the grammar. 3d models have been customely made and used to decorate Newlan High. While also updating the map to version 1.21.11.**

![](https://i.imgur.com/QPvtB4L.png)

Newlan High is a character and story-driven horror map. So it is more focused on the story than the jumpscares. It takes around 2 hours to complete. Newlan High: Reborn is a sequel to [Panoris High Reborn](https://www.minecraftmaps.com/49138-panoris-high-reborn)[.](https://www.minecraftmaps.com/49138-panoris-high-reborn) It is advised to have played the prequel first.

![](https://i.imgur.com/ea1JSJq.png)

**The Story so far:**

It has been a few months since Skyler escaped from a haunted school called Panoris High. She managed to make it back to the camp safely. Shortly after reuniting with her class they went back to their home town of Newlan Peaks after their camp trip to Rosegard. However, it seems like something has followed Skyler back home. Because soon enough, she got a weird dream and a heavy snowstorm mysteriously appeared soon after. The storm blocked off any way to leave the school just like what happened to the students of class 10 of 2010 back in Panoris High. Trapped in your own school while all kinds of strange things occur around you. It is once again time to explore a school. Only this time the school that you think you know so well. Will reveal their dark secrets hidden for over a decade to you. While you are exploring the schools blocked off floors. Only nightmares can explain your biggest fears for what is happening. Skylers worries about the curse having fallen on her own class has become a reality when the first victim has fallen and the fourth tragedy begins...

![](https://i.imgur.com/0rmmvDN.png)

**Some of the features :**

- **Explore a big school with 2 floors and a basement**

- **Books and decoration with additional lore has been hidden around the school.**

- **Several unique characters from your sleepy friend to a insane girl**

- **Some references to the prequel**

- **Collectables for you to find.**

- **Custom music from copyright free composers. (Credits to **[**NCM Epic Music**](https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCHEioEoqyFPsOiW8CepDaYg/videos)**, **[**Darren Curtis**](https://www.youtube.com/user/DesperateMeasurez/videos)**, **[**Kevin Macload**](https://www.youtube.com/user/kmmusic)**)**

- **3d models**

- **Secrets!**

![](https://i.imgur.com/ifv8IHw.png)

**Future updates:**

Let me know if you find any bugs. Or any of the directions your supposed to go to isn't clear.

**Some last notes :**

- My #1 goal was to make this map more user-friendly than the prequel and make most characters more memorable rather than the many forgettable ones that were in the prequel.

- Even though this map is mostly focused on the story and the atmosphere it still contains jumpscares.

- Play it in 1.21.11!

- It was made for singleplayer. But multiplayer might work too.

readme:
**[=-=-=-=-= Rock Paper Scissors Tag! =-=-=-=-=]**

In this unique take on a regular game of tag, a group of players will play the usual game of Tag in Minecraft, except when the Tagger tags a Runner, they must play Rock Paper Scissors with them, and whoever loses becomes the next tagger, or if it's the Tagger that loses, they remain the Tagger! Every two seconds that a Runner is alive and not the Tagger, they gain a point! If a Tagger defeats a Runner in RPS, they gain 10 points, and if a Runner defeats a Tagger, they gain 5 points! Do the best you can to not get tagged, because whoever has the most points at the end of the game is crowned the winner!

There are four different stages, and options for the game to range anywhere from one minute long to 8 minutes long. In addition, there is a secondary mode to this map called "Hide and Seek Mode," where the stages expand in size to have hiding spots, and the Tagger/Seeker must find all the Runners/Hiders before the time runs out -- while also defeating them in Rock Paper Scissors!

readme:
#

Monster Industries: Rebirth

![](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/1587/101/the-map-png.png)

Two teams, one goal: Run your company better than the other guys and come out on top.

Each team controls their own production company and races to push their stock value to 750, 1000, or 1500, depending on how long you want the game to go. The main loop is simple: gather resources, buy monster eggs, and send those monsters into the tunnels to mess with the other team.

---

#

How It Works

###

Resource Gathering

Head into the yard and knock out basic tasks to collect materials:

paper

,

coal

, bone, gunpowder,

spider eyes

. Paper is the backbone of everything. You can buy slaves to automate paper production and scale things up faster.

###

Spending and Upgrades

Pay with paper as your currency. Use it to buy food, armor, and spawn eggs, or put it toward upgrades that automate your operation. The more you invest early, the less manual work you're doing later.

###

Sending Monsters

Once you've got eggs, take them to the wall dividing the two companies and push monsters into the tunnels. They'll flood into the enemy side and cause problems. Dying costs your company 100 stock, so keeping pressure on the other team matters. Keep Inventory is on, so you won't lose your stuff on death.

###

Stock and Tactics

As your stock grows, you unlock special business tactics. These can shift the momentum if things aren't going your way, so it's worth thinking about when to use them rather than just hoarding stock.

---

#

What's New in Rebirth

- Every mob now has three difficulty tiers, so the monsters you're dealing with vary in how dangerous they are

- A settings room lets you toggle specific mobs, turn off monster levels, or disable certain rooms entirely

- The map is fully replayable: no one-time setup, just reset and go again

- New victory map added

- No command blocks

- Play on the latest version of Minecraft

---

description: 1 to 1 copy of Lucky 38 casino from Fallout:New Vegas
readme:
The tower is 240 blocks tall, so in case you want to copy the build into your world/server there are 17 blocks of margin starting from the sea level, so it should fit in just fine in most biomes

Main issue I've faced through the entire build process was the fact that the New Vegas model of Lucky 38 is kind of a mess. First of all, it's severely underscaled. In fact, it is so small, that all of the in-game interiors are larger than the tower model. Second of all, the design of the top of the tower is different between interior and exterior models. For instance, exterior model completely misses the penthouse floor, while cocktail lounge floor got different proportions compared to the interior.

Since the "saucer" part of the cocktail lounge is the only thing that technically exists in both interior and exterior models, I decided to use it as proportional reference for the entire build. Once I've scaled it up more or less accurately to the Minecraft player size, it was quite easy to figure out the rest of the tower.

So far the interiors of cocktail lounge and penthouse are quite basic, as I had to minimize the use of any solid blocks, to avoid making that giant shadow over the entire build, so I basically ended up with stained glass and carpets for all the floors, since they do not obstruct any light. There is some shadow overcast in the final build, caused by the trims made from solid vlocks, but it's almost unnoticeable.

readme:
Note:

This map is originally published in Simplified Chinese, which has [this](https://www.bilibili.com/opus/1195937616442163218) as a Chinese introduction for you to read.

A language pack is contained in the save file, which supports you to play in English(US). You may need to change your game language to switch. It works as a resource pack so it only works on the client which installed it!

---

## **◆ **Gameplay

"Midnight Soul" is an

**ABA map**

 built on Minecraft Java. You will play as either a Soul or a Soul Guardian, striving for victory through evasion and pursuit.

As a

Soul

, yearning to rebuild your physical form, you need to collect scattered Soul Shards and release the aura within them. When the surrounding aura becomes dense enough, a portal will emerge—charge it completely before the aura dissipates, and you can return to the living world through it, a process we call

"revive"

.

As a

Soul Guardian

, tasked with maintaining the balance of the world, your objective is simple: stop the Souls. Whether by knocking them down so they can no longer sustain their existence, or by blocking their path until their aura is completely exhausted, you can cause them to

"perish"

, eventually turning into lingering regrets that return to the earth.

More detailed gameplay and mechanics are explained in-game. You can check the in-game tutorial, which is located in the "Tutorial" tab under the Advancements menu. When you encounter a mechanic for the first time, a corresponding tip will also appear in the chat—so be sure to pay attention!

---

## **◆ **Features

- **Diverse Abilities**

**:** Turn into a puff of smoke before the guardian, instantly appear beside a soul, or even swap positions with your own teammates?! We offer a wide variety of talents, skills, and relics – welcome to experience them all.

- **Random Events**

**:** Want a different gameplay experience? No problem! Echoes are global random effects that trigger by chance. They may alter certain mechanics, or even change the entire gameplay!

- **Well-Balanced**

**:** After incorporating numerous test results and player feedback, we've fine-tuned the balance across all mechanics. The game is now quite well-balanced, ensuring a great match experience for everyone.

- **Audiovisual Design**

**:** Every ability and mechanic in the game is carefully paired with custom sound and visual effects. If you're skilled enough, you can even use them to gain a competitive advantage!

- **Highly Customizable**

**:** Most mechanics can be adjusted – from how abilities are selected to whether random events are triggered. We also have a dedicated debug panel that even allows you to

**add your own maps to play**

!

- **Quantified Performance**

**:** Our sophisticated scoring algorithm calculates your performance based on in-game actions. And if you want to keep the atmosphere friendly, the debug panel also includes an option to hide rating scores!

- **Play Incentives**

**:** What's more, we offer a variety of cosmetics to reward your playtime... or perhaps to encourage you to uncover some hidden secrets?

---

**Recommanded** player amount: 5~10

**[=-=-=-=-= Sorry! Board Game in Minecraft! =-=-=-=-=] **

Sorry: the game of sweet revenge! In this fully-functioning Minecraft remake of a classic game board, you must carry 4 pawns from your starting area, around a 60-space board, to your home base, while knocking back your opponents! Can you get your pawns home as quickly and safely as possible, or will you end up feeling *sorry???*

Each round, players take turns pulling a card from the deck to either move their pawn forward, or knock opponent pawns' back! Some cards give you options with special abilities to let you build your strategy to win! But mostly, if you ever land on someone's pawn, you send that person's pawn back to their start! Land on a slide to boost your pawn forward even more! The game is suited for 2-4 players in Minecraft 1.21.11!

Try out some of the other settings too! For example, try playing in Trouble! mode! It turns the game into the board game Trouble!, which works similarly to Sorry! but uses dice and is more simplified!

readme:
**Pool Party** is a

legendary

 and perhaps the most recognizable map in the history of **Pixel Gun 3D**, which has become a real cultural phenomenon among players. A kind of remake of the classic location *fy_pool_day* from *Counter-Strike*, it is a compact backyard of a luxury mansion with a large rectangular pool in the very center.

**The map's popularity** is due to its extreme dynamics: due to the tiny size of the arena, players come face to face almost instantly after respawning. This turns every match into an incessant "*meat*" stream of shootouts, dominated by shotguns, edged weapons and fast gadgets. Pool Party is considered an ideal training ground for honing the skills of "*3-cat spam*" (quickly switching between categories of weapons) and conducting one-on-one duels.

**Visually**, the location is simple but functional: two symmetrical recreation areas with changing booths (red and blue sides) and roofs, which experienced fighters climb using rocket jumps to gain a tactical advantage. Despite the appearance of many new maps, the **Pool **remains the gold standard for pure, concentrated adrenaline.

name: Settlers of Catan: Minecraft Edition
description: A command-block recreation of the classic board game Settlers of Catan, with all the rules built in to ensure fair play! Best experienced with 4 players!
readme:
**Settlers of Catan** is a classic 4-player board game where players collect resources to build roads, settlements and cities in order to reach 10 victory points. Players roll dice for resources, trade with opponents and use strategy to expand their kingdom across a modular island board.

Players start in the lobby, a quaint living room with 4 seats surrounding a table holding a Catan board. Once ready, press the button and be transported into the board, built at scale in Minecraft. Play on the beginner board or a randomized board so no game is the same. Use strategy to ensure you come out on top!

This recreation is made solely using command blocks (no datapacks) in vanilla Minecraft, and has all the rules of classic 4-player Catan built in, including domestic and maritime trades, robber logic and resource allocation. Note that players will receive resources in their inventories and dropping them will make them disappear, but this does not affect the gameplay as all resources are being kept track of behind the scenes, along with victory points and card counts as per the rules of Catan.

- Technically supports **1 - 4** **players **(although 1 player is lonely)

- Recommend** 3 - 4** **players **for the most fun (4 is the best)

- Allows **3** **spectators **for a maximum of **7** online players

- Each game of Catan should last around **40 minutes**

The full rules of the game are outlined here: [https://www.catan.com/sites/default/files/2021-06/catan_base_rules_2020_200707.pdf](https://www.catan.com/sites/default/files/2021-06/catan_base_rules_2020_200707.pdf)

I suggest skimming through the rules as the game is quite complicated (if you are new to Catan), and playing on the **beginner board** as you learn to outsmart your friends!

readme:

**Minecraft**: 26.1

**

Resource Pack:

**[**https://www.mediafire.com/folder/rx69oqucdh1h4/Lucky-Pillar**](https://www.mediafire.com/folder/rx69oqucdh1h4/Lucky-Pillar)

## **Game Introduction**

**Lucky Pillar** is a multiplayer game based on Minecraft. Players are randomly distributed on towering pillars on a platform, using randomly distributed items to deal with various random events, defeat other players, and survive to the end to become the winner!

### **Core Gameplay**

- **Multiplayer Competition**: Support 2-∞ players competing simultaneously

- **Random Items**: Receive different weapons and items randomly each round

- **Dynamic Events**: Various random events triggered during gameplay

- **Survival Challenge**: Survive on limited platforms and defeat opponents

- **Mod Compatibility**: Install certain mods to get additional content

- **Multi-language Support:** Currently supports: 简/繁体中文、English

## **Main Features**

### **Maps**

```
| Map | Description |
|---------|----------|
| **Wool** | Classic |
| **Nether** | Classic Dimension: The Nether |
| **Glass** | Classic |
| **TNT** | Classic |
| **Trap Door** | Classic |
| **Ocean** | Special Obtain items through fishing, water is highly toxic |
| **Moon** | Special Low Gravity |
```

### **Random Event System**

The following events are randomly triggered during gameplay:

```
| Event Name | Effect Description |
|------------|-------------------|
| **Night Falls** | Turn to night, spawn two phantoms |
| **Anvil Drop** | Spawn anvils above players' heads |
| **Dragon Attack** | Spawn Ender Dragon to attack all players |
| **Wither** | Spawn Wither Boss |
| **FLY** | Obtain elytra and fireworks rockets |
| **Arrow Rain** | 10-second continuous arrow rain attack |
| **Sky Walker** | Levitation |
| **Rotation** | Player automatically rotate |
| **Lightning Strike** | Random lightning attacks |
| **Hello, World** | Turn to daytime, fully restores health |
| **「Undying」** | Obtain a totem of undying |
| **Broken Leg** | Unable to jump |
| **One-Hit Kill** | Player attack damage becomes 40 |
| **CREEPER** | Summon a creeper, with 10% chance of charged creeper |
| **Pat Pat** | Player entity interaction distance becomes 10 |
| **Inventory Exchange** | Player's inventory items are randomly exchanged |
| **King Game** | Winner takes all |
| **Lucky Doll** | Obtain an enhanced totem of undying |
| **Starving Starving** | Gain Hunger (40) for 30 seconds |
| **Darkness** | Darkness (10s) |
| **Speed** | 🦽 Sprint Sprint 🦽 |
| **Miniaturization** | Player size -0.8 |
| **Gigantification** | Player size +4 |
| **Nuclear Power** | Summon a charged creeper named 'Broken Broken' |
| **Rainy Day** | Weather changes to rain, obtain a trident with Riptide III |
| **Greedy Slime** | Spawn a slime, eating drops increases in size |
| **Location Exchange** | Random exchange of player locations |
| **Lava Rising** | Lava rises at a speed of 1 b/s |
| **LOOK ME** | Look at a player |
| **I'm famous** | Self-ignites in sunlight |
| **Key Inversion** | WASD is reversed |
```

### **Special Rules**

Globally effective

```
| Rule Name | Effect Description |
|-----------|-------------------|
| **Small but Cute** | Players' size reduced to 1/3 of original |
| **Big! Big! Big!** | Players' size increased to 3/2 of original |
| **My Partner** | Obtain a fox that provides strength and health regeneration while alive |
| **One-Hit Kill** | Player attack damage becomes 40 |
| **Inventory Exchange** | Random events are fixed to Inventory Exchange |
| **I sea you** | Player gains Invisibility, gains 5s Glowing after event |
| **Void Mercy** | Player falls into the void will be teleported upward by **60** blocks |
```

### **Game Mechanics**

**Border System**

- World border gradually shrinks over time

- When border shrinks to 5 blocks wide, platforms start collapsing

- Each collapse height is 30 blocks

**Compatibility List**

- All Enchantments

- [Farmer's Delight](https://modrinth.com/mod/7vxePowz)

- [Mutant Monsters](https://modrinth.com/mod/derP0ten)

### **OP Command**

```
| Command | Function |
| ----------- | ----------- |
| `function yw-pillar:game/end` | End the game directly |
| `function yw-pillar:utils/game/player_left_halfway`   | Handle a player leaving midway |
| `function yw-pillar:utils/game/skip_event`   | Skip current event |
```

**The Legend of the Crimson Forest**

In a world where the rarest wood holds the ultimate power, you are a lone survivor with one goal: find the **Red Sandalwood**. But you aren't alone. As the sun sets, the shadows come alive. **Pillagers** and monsters want the treasure for themselves and will stop at nothing to hunt you down.

**Features:**

- **Unique Economy:** Harvest Red Sandalwood and trade it for custom currency and powerful items.

- **Progression System:** Use your earnings to buy elite upgrades, armor, and weapons specifically designed for dragon hunting.

- **Nightmare Mode:** Every night, the difficulty spikes. Defend your base against waves of Pillagers and Mobs.

- **Final Boss:** A custom-scaled Ender Dragon fight that requires maximum upgrades to win

- **Can you survive the greed of the Pillagers?**

🌳💰 In this custom survival map, your mission is to find the rare **Red Sandalwood**, get rich, and gear up for the ultimate showdown against the **Ender Dragon**.

- ⚔️ **Survive** the night raids.

- 💎 **Upgrade** your arsenal.

- 🐉 **Defeat** the Dragon.

*Don't give up. The forest depends on you!*

description: An astroid struck the Island and Woke up the ancient architects of the Cosmos | The most In-Depth open world, Hightech experience you will find on minecraft
readme:
### **Story Synopsis:**

Deep in the frigid waters near Canada, an island once ruled by a barbaric tribe fell to a mainland conglomerate known as **Cell**. After seizing the territory, Cell exploited local knowledge to harvest aetherial energy from mysterious veins beneath the rock, using the resource to fuel an unprecedented technological surge toward the mainland.

Their dominance was absolute. until an asteroid tore through the atmosphere and struck the island. The impact awakened a primordial force that had inhabited the Earth’s crust long before the dawn of man. Now, these ancient guardians have risen to reclaim their stolen power, vowing to destroy anyone who dares to siphon the planet's lifeblood.

### **Gameplay Mechanics: Nano Combat**

**Nano Suit **-

Maximum Strength

 |

Maximum Speed

 |

Cloak

| Maximum Armor

Built for the comfort of the player, Left click to select a Combat mode, Right click to Activate.

**Power-Ups** - Some soldiers will drop various power ups to enchance your combat.

**Alertness System** - Your actions / progress in the open world and in story missions will progress an Alertness Meter, once the meter is full, Elite Cell soldiers will hunt you and surprise attack you.

**Elite Soldiers** - Some soldiers will have special abilities, That will react to your Suit's combat mode and more!

### **Open World Mechanics:**

**Main Missions** - Right now there are 4 in the Demo, story driven explosive missions!

**Radio Towers **- Liberate radio towers owned by Cell to reveal POI's, Trading centers, and black markets.

**POI's / Businesses** - While roaming the open world, you will have various POI's that will serve as "side missions" Liberate the POI's and you will be able to buy it with in game currency as a business. After a POI is bought, it will deliver ingridients every in game morning, those can be used on black markets to buy special items.

**Black markets** - Appear only at night, unlocked by progressing the story / world activities. they offer unique items and weaponry like an Airstrike remote for special ingredients found in the world.

**Shops **- Unlocked after completing a story mission, using basic currency for traditional loot and weapons.

**Trading Centers** - Villages that will trade everything in the game, Both regular currency, ingredients and even things like selling weapons for money.

More to be found in the world...

readme:
## Escape The Puzzle House 2

Welcome to **Escape The Puzzle House 2**.

You do **not** need to have played *Escape The Puzzle House 1* to play this map. The stories are not connected.

You stand before an old, abandoned house — silent, forgotten, and filled with secrets. Somewhere inside lies an ancient treasure, left to you as an inheritance. But the house does not give up its secrets willingly. The walls hide mechanisms, the rooms conceal puzzles, and the silence is often broken by sounds that may guide… or mislead you.

To claim what is yours, you must explore carefully, think logically, and pay close attention to your surroundings. Every decision matters. Every sound matters. The house is watching.

Good luck. Few make it out unchanged.

---

## Rules & Information

- This map can be played solo or with multiple players.

- You must remain in **Adventure Mode** at all times.

- You may do anything that is possible within Adventure Mode.

- Paintings may be removed if necessary, but the intended experience is best preserved if they remain.

- **Sound must be enabled.** Certain puzzles and pathways rely on audio cues.

- As with my other maps, **10 hidden points** are scattered throughout the house for players who explore thoroughly.

- If you encounter any bugs, errors, or unintended exploits, please report them so the map can be improved.

Proceed with caution… and enjoy your escape 🕯️🧩

readme:
###

I wanted to answer the following question at the start of this post now that I'm updating this map: "

*

When is Chapter 4?!

*

"

**The Answer:** *"Coming eventually". As the team and I continue to get older, we've become very busy with irl stuff in our personal lives. Chapter 4 is still in development, but is taking much longer than originally anticipated. However, I can say it WILL eventually release! Thank you for your patience in the meantime!*

# **

OVER 2 YEARS IN THE MAKING!

**

Hello everyone, after over 2 years of development I am ecstatic and proud to finally share the next chapter in the Kitatcho Laboratories series! What was originally planned to be the final chapter in what would have been a trilogy of maps, we've decided to split the map in 2 as our ambitions for this series exceeded what we could realistically put into just one map. Because of this, expect Chapter 4 to hopefully come out sometime next year!

**

MAP FEATURES

**

In the meantime, Chapter 3 is still much bigger and more ambitious than the previous 2 chapters, and features the following:

- Over 20+ Chambers/Puzzles to solve!

- A fully voice-acted story!

- An original soundtrack with over 35 songs!

- Roughly 8-10 hours of gameplay (Over double the length of the previous maps)!

- A heavier emphasis on story, lore, and secrets!

- Slimeballs... like, a LOT of slimeballs.

**

DO I NEED TO PLAY THE PREVIOUS MAPS?

**

If you're new to the series you should be able to play Chapter 3 without needing to play the other maps while still having a fun and fulfilling experience, but we would still recommend you check out Chapters 1 and 2 so you can get a better understanding on the lore and running jokes throughout the three maps!

**

PREVIOUS MAPS

**

You can check out the previous chapters here*:

Chapter 1 - [https://www.minecraftmaps.com/puzzle-maps/the-kitatcho-laboratories-chapter-1-2020-reboot](https://www.minecraftmaps.com/puzzle-maps/the-kitatcho-laboratories-chapter-1-2020-reboot)

Chapter 2 - [https://www.minecraftmaps.com/puzzle-maps/the-kitatcho-laboratories-chapter-2](https://www.minecraftmaps.com/puzzle-maps/the-kitatcho-laboratories-chapter-2)

*Just make sure to play them in their appropriate Minecraft versions

**

CAN I PLAY WITH A FRIEND?

**

Chapter 3 is meant to be played in Singleplayer, and isn't recommended to be played with a friend. However, we did try our best to accommodate the map for 2 people, but this hasn't been reliably tested and we can't confirm the map will work as intended. If you do decide to play with a friend, **play at your own risk!**

**

THANK YOU!!!

**

Seriously, the amount of love and support we received for the first two chapters was beyond what we were expecting, and this gave us the motivation and ambition to create something on a whole other level than those maps. We really hope you enjoy the map, and please feel free to join our Discord to share any thoughts/feedback (which is linked in the map)!

We look forward to continuing to deliver more maps in the future with Chapter 4 and beyond!

# **

WELCOME BACK TO THE KITATCHO LABORATORIES

**

Hello everyone, and welcome to the long-awaited sequel to last year's "The Kitatcho Laboratories - Chapter 1". This map has been in development for almost half a year (can you believe that?) and we're happy to finally share what we made with all of you!

The map takes place 15 years after the events of Chapter 1, where you're reawoken from cryogenic refrigeration to participate in a new round of tests to celebrate the Kitatcho Laboratories 25th anniversary! Look forward to what this new and improved version of the facility has to offer!

**

FEATURES

**

- 15 original chambers

- New custom mechanics to keep the puzzles fresh and exciting

- A fully voice-acted story

- A 100% original soundtrack (that won't flag any YouTube videos, don't worry!)

- A new and improved texture pack

- Slimeballs. What more could you want?

### **

Q&A

**

***

Can I play this map with a friend?

***

- This map is designed with single-player in mind, but we've done our best to make it multiplayer compatible (in theory). Just treat the map as if you and your friend(s) were one person and try not to exploit or cheat anything!

***

I'm stuck on a puzzle. I think it's broken?

***

- This map has been extensively beta-tested by dozens of players (thank you all who took part in testing), so we can assure you all puzzles are 100% possible. A walkthrough will be made sometime in the near future, but until then just keep trying your best if you're stuck!

***

How can I show my support?

***

- The best way you can show your support for the hard work we've put into this map is to share it with your friends! If you ever want to provide us with any feedback or criticism directly, please visit our discord server (link found inside the map). We'll be happy to have you!

readme:
You live your daily life as a hunter in a world where creepers are long extinct. But one day, while hunting, you noticed something impossible...

The Hunter lived a simple life. He hunted deer and wild boar in the forests surrounding Norton, a village nestled beside the Silverstream River. His days were peaceful, the forest echoing only with the calls of birds and the rustling of leaves. He was grateful for the peace, especially knowing that the world hadn’t always been this way.

Generations ago, the land had been terrorized by creepers – grotesque, self-detonating monstrosities that haunted the shadows. Now, they were just cautionary tales told to children, a nightmare long since vanished.

One autumn morning, the hunter tracked a bear deep into the woods. He drew his bow, the bear frozen mid-stride, a perfect shot. But as he lowered his bow, something else caught his eye...

readme:
A tornado has touched down on the island of Mine Zealand! Make your way up the 320-block tall tornado in windy conditions (yes, wind in Minecraft) and save the Mayor at the top of the tornado!

Tragedy has struck the island of Mine Zealand, where a supermassive tornado has touched down and is sucking everything up, including the Mayor of the island! Your mission is to parkour up the tornado in dangerous conditions and save the Mayor at the very top of the tornado!
By downloading this map, you agree to put yourself in dire conditions that may result in injury or death.
Because this is a tornado, and tornadoes are known for being extremely windy, there will be wind pushing you around as you're parkouring! (Yes, they put wind in Minecraft!) You can set how strong the wind is before starting, ranging from very low (super easy) to very high (super hard). If you're playing on a server, I suggest not having it blow high or very high as I have found it causes server lag. (Thanks to [MulverineX's datapack](https://github.com/MulverineX/player_motion/) for allowing the wind mechanic)

readme:

Disclaimer: Please check out the original "[Parkour Spiral](29139-parkour-spiral)" map by Hielke before playing!

This is a much more challenging version of the famous "Parkour Spiral" map created by Hielke. It is a buffed version with completely altered and remade gameplay throughout the entire map, similar to kaizo mods in Mario games. Some sections are very cruel, namely the outside sections where you have almost nothing to save yourself on if you fall. This isn't meant for casual players, and should only be attempted by those who have a lot of prior experience with parkour.

There is also some quite specific tech used throughout the map, however it has all been thoroughly tested and is possible in 1.21.1! Every stage has a solution. If you get stuck, I would recommend asking other parkour players if they can figure out what to do!

Additional information on the gameplay will be given at spawn and the first few stages.

Good luck, and hopefully you can find fun in the suffering!

readme:
**

Resource Pack

The city looks best when using the Alma Bay Resource Pack. The pack is provided within the world download or can be downloaded separately

[**here**](https://www.planetminecraft.com/texture-pack/alma-bay-official-resource-pack/)

---

**

About Alma Bay

**

This is Alma Bay, a solo city project by Minenitrogue. The city, which began construction on 3 October 2021, is being built on a custom WorldPainter map. The map has a large river running through the middle of the city , a coast with beach to the east, mountains to the north-west and a large bay also to the east.

There are several areas of the city. The downtown area of the city is made up of many office buildings, skyscrapers, shops and apartment buildings. These buildings contain a variety of different building styles, from 1700s style buildings to 2020s style buildings. The suburbs also contain many different styles of houses from different eras. There is also a seafront area which has many shops as well as a pier and small marina.

South of the city, there is a full scale regional airport. The airport has one runway and one passenger terminal. In the mountains there is a hydroelectric dam and winding country roads.

The city's architecture is a mix of American/British with the Downtown area mostly based off American architecture, and the suburb areas mostly based off British architecture. Every building has a fully furnished interior to explore.

readme:
Scylla Republic, 1919. Nearly two decades after Joey Dmitri saved the world from the Undead, a deadly disease has begun to spread across the Caribbean island of Presland, turning citizens into Undead monsters. There is seemingly no way out, as those around you begin to suffer. That is, until you forge your legacy as humanity’s next savior in the hit open-world horror adventure map of 2025: **Revengeance III**.

The Revengeance map series began four years ago and has amassed over 50,000 combined downloads since. Now, Revengeance III is the epic finale to the trilogy, expanding and building upon everything that made the first two maps great. Revengeance III is an action-packed horror adventure map complete with a 12-story campaign, side quests, an in-game currency system, boss battles, a huge open world, wanted level system, custom voice acting, and much more. This map is Chris6d’s tenth map overall, and his finest work yet. It’s the map you didn’t know you needed until now.

You don’t need to play the other Revengeance maps before playing this one (unless you want some story context), but if you want to play them afterwards, go for it. All of the rules and settings, as well as the Resource Pack, will be provided when you load the map. All levels have been tested numerous times by multiple people, and are possible to complete. So please download the map and play it for yourself, and feel free to make YouTube videos and walkthroughs of this map!

Must play in Java 1.21.4 only. Start at 808 -50 609 if you’re not there already.

readme:
Rexurbem is a medieval steampunk map that I have been making for 3 years.

## English

Welcome to REXURBEM – A Collaborative Medieval City

**Version:** Minecraft Java 1.21.3

 **Goal:** To collectively build a coherent and immersive medieval city, with a strict selection process to ensure stylistic harmony.

My name is Hippo. I've been working solo on this map for 3 years, and now I’m opening it up to the world so you can **add your personal touch**.

The process is simple: apply to join the server (show me your best builds!), I’ll assign you a plot (a house, a street, a shop, etc., based on your preferences), and then you help move this beautiful project forward.

This project was born out of a passion: to build a believable, detailed, and lively medieval city. Every street, every façade, every stone was designed to form a harmonious whole. But a city can’t be built alone… and that’s where you come in.

To join the server, contact me on Discord to apply and build your finest creation! : [https://discord.gg/WcTdbWJE](https://discord.gg/WcTdbWJE)

Tempus, founder of the town of Mort's Hollow and brilliant scientist. You begin your day by starting work as the overnight custodian at the Tempus Science Laboratory, but things quickly go horribly wrong.

readme:

Tempus Mortem is a single-player game originally built in survival on Season 5 of Zedcraft, Zedaph's patron server. This version has only been updated a small amount to work better as a standalone map.

It is a puzzle game where the goal is essentially to learn how it works and get to the inside. Think of it more as a very large puzzle box. It includes many rooms that can (and should) be explored in any order and do not need to be solved sequentially.

There is no serious parkour and you won't be chased by monsters, so it's just you against the building. Most players take around 3-4 hours to complete this game.

name: Parkour Heaven
readme:
An ambitious parkour map inspired by old-school 3D platformers

Welcome to the Parkour Heaven Demo! This demo contains three levels from my upcoming parkour map, which hopefully will release sometime within the next 1000 or so years. After a long hiatus I have risen from the grave to give you a taste of my most ambitious map yet. Taking inspiration from old-school 3D platformers, Parkour Heaven focuses on delivering a unique and varied experience with features such as moving platforms, powerups, and loads of hidden secrets and bonus stages.
Each stage contains:
Three emeralds
One hidden diamond
One gold from the bonus level in each stage
Power ups / abilities / other trinkets
Launchpads: Stepping on a launchpad and pressing the jump key will allow you to jump to extended heights
Prismarine Shards: Some stages require you to collect 5 prismarine shards in an area to unlock an exit or activate a launchpad
Crossbow: The crossbow allows you to hit targets, which can activate platforms, open doors, or engage in other sorts of funky business
Color Blocks: Some stages contain colored blocks that activate different paths. Step on one to get to the goal in another way
Remember, this is a demo
There are bound to be some bugs in here that I am both aware and unaware of. If you find anything gamebreaking please report it and I will try my best to fix it. I pulled my hair out getting a lot of the map logic to work properly so hopefully I didn't gloss over anything too potentially catastrophic
Credits:

name: Candy Land in Minecraft!
readme:
Fully-functioning Candy Land board game in Minecraft, with items, challenges, and playable minigames! Can you make it to Candy Castle?

## Candy Land in Minecraft!

Venture through the vast board-game world of Candy Land from your childhood in Minecraft! Gather a group of 2–5 people, outlast your opponents, and be the first person to reach the finish space. Every few rounds, play a minigame that’ll reward you based on your score. Land on challenge spaces that determine whether you move forward or back. Collect and use items along the way to help yourself—or hinder others!

[ DOWNLOAD RESOURCE PACK FOR MULTIPLAYER! (Google Drive) ](https://drive.google.com/file/d/1VPQrKl4vYgcLE8bIIVs2tiAMRBmsF7_0/view?usp=drive_link)

In addition to the **44 minigames, 20 challenges, and 18 items**, there are 4 boards to choose from:

## Boards

- Classic

 — *Difficulty: 1/5* — A Minecraft remake of the classic Milton Bradley Candy Land board game! Traverse candy lands and be the first to reach King Candy’s Castle.
- Lava Cake Mountain

 — *Difficulty: 4/5* — An active chocolate-lava volcano with five layers, each hiding a lever. Flick them all to unlock the bridge, but beware: every 8 rounds it erupts and destroys bridges!
- Sugar Rush Raceway

 — *Difficulty: 2.5/5* — Compete in 5 laps at the Jerries Speedway. Spam items Mario-Kart style for chaos!
- Toxic Waste Land

 — *Difficulty: 3.5/5* — A radioactive wasteland with gates, broken bridges, and even parkour. Can you survive the toxic world of 2105?

*More boards will come in the future!*

## Important Settings

- Compatible with **2–5 players**. Others can spectate.
- Play on **Minecraft 1.21.8**. Reset if loaded on another version.
- Enable **command blocks**. Reset if off.
- **Do NOT** use Lunar Client.
- Install the resource pack above and remove excess ones (shaders are fine).

name: Which Doesn't Belong: Warden Unleashed
readme:
The suspenseful way to play!

Which Doesn't Belong: Warden Unleashed (WDB:WU) is a Which Doesn't Belong (WDB) type map where you find and gather the question itself! There are 8 droppers around the map with 4 of them containing a WDB question block. Once you find all four, you must place them down at the question set station and answer which doesn't belong! If you answer correctly, you can escape the map! This is easier said than done as there is a Warden trying to hunt you down. Evade the Warden and escape alive!

## Gamemodes

•Story Mode (This mode acts as a tutorial, showing you how to play. It does, however, stand alone as its own fun gamemode!)
•Normal Mode (This is the main way to play! Find the question blocks and evade the Warden!)
•Be The Warden (Now YOU can become the Warden and chase players down!)

## Maps

•Ancient Ruins
•Library Labyrinth
•Jungle Chaos

## Rules

•Gamemode: Adventure
•Difficulty: Normal
•Render Distance: 10 chunks
•Graphics: Fancy
•Particles: All

## YouTube Channels

I run multiple YouTuber channels! My biggest two are [King Boba Fett](https://www.youtube.com/@KingBobaFett) and [Extractalore](https://www.youtube.com/@Extractalore)! King Boba Fett is where I do Minecraft content.

## More Info

name: The Complex: An Open-World Maze
readme:
My best maze yet: an open-world maze map, made up of over 50 unique and challenging regions!!

Welcome to The Complex: An Open-World Maze!!!

As the name suggests, this map is an open-world maze map- and it’s pretty complex, too! As with all mazes, your goal is to reach the end! Of course, you may have to make a few pit stops along the way-

What *is* an open world maze?

Well, it's a large system of mazes broken down into sub-regions you can explore and find your way through, and make your way towards your goals via a number of different routes- each one challenging in different ways! If you find that one region is too tough for you, you can spring for a different one instead!

How long will it take to play?

That depends on both you and your skill level- but definitely a couple hours at minimum. Don’t worry, though: the regions are divided in such a way that you switch between them often, so good pause points can often be found- and there’s a checkpoint system in play too!

Is there anything else to know?

Well, the map is played in the most recent version: 1.21.1! It’s designed for singleplayer but most (if not all of) everything should work in multiplayer too! Also, every single water maze in the entire map is avoidable, save for a single (short and simple) one!

And that’s all?

Sure is!! Have fun exploring the complex world of The Complex: An Open-World Maze!!!

***If ya need any help or have any questions or just have something to say, feel free to join [my discord!](https://discord.gg/zJpRATM)***

name: Tower of Rod
readme:
Tower Of Rod is a Parkour Speedrun Map, complete with a speedrun stopwatch that tracks your time on runs and saves your fastest run as a personal best.

The map starts you off in the lobby, where you can jump right into the parkour by clicking on the sign that says "Start". Checkpoints are represented by cut copper blocks. To restart from a checkpoint, simply right-click while holding the "Restart From Checkpoint" item in your hand. Once the course is complete, you will be greeted with three options.

1. Reset The Map - Clears all scores, and makes it like a fresh playthrough

2. Clear Personal Best - Resets your personal best score

3. Start A New Run - Begins a new run from the beginning of the course while keeping your previous run time to compare against

## Installation:

After downloading the map, unzip the file by extracting it, and copy or move the extracted world folder

(Tower Of Rod)

to your Minecraft saves folder. The typical folder structure on Windows looks like this ---> Local DiskUsers(your PC user)AppDataRoaming.minecraftsaves

If you don't see the AppData folder in your users folder, you can enable show hidden files by checking hidden files in the View dropdown menu. You can also

get to the AppData folder by searching "run" in the start menu, pressing Enter, and then typing %appdata% and pressing Enter.

readme:
A map like the board game "Guess Who" but with Minecraft blocks 1v1

## “A map like the board game *Guess Who*, but with Minecraft blocks”

A Minecraft minigame where the mechanics of *Guess Who* are reimagined using Minecraft blocks instead of faces. Each player is presented with a grid of different blocks. At the start of each round, players are randomly assigned a secret block. They then take turns asking yes/no questions to narrow down the possibilities and figure out the opponent’s block.

## Example Questions

- Is your block a type of wood?
- Is it naturally generated?
- Can you craft your block into stairs?

## Note

You can customize the grid however you like.

## Languages

- العربية / Arabic

name: Torn: Fallen Angels
readme:
Five years after the X.I.A. Agency defeated the First Sons, the world is in peril once again as the Agency is on the brink of collapse. As the final remaining Agent, it’s up to you to save it in the hit open-world adventure map of Torn: Fallen Angels.

Five years after Agent X27 saved the world from the First Sons, the X.I.A. Agency is on the brink of collapse. As Z99, the final remaining Agent, it’s up to you to foil the First Sons’ doomsday plans in the city of Staumont, while rescuing those close to you who have been captured by the government, and making new allies along the way.

The Torn map series began in 2019 and has amassed over 50,000 combined downloads since. Now, **Torn: Fallen Angels** is the epic finale to the trilogy, expanding and building upon everything that made the first two maps great. Torn: Fallen Angels is an action-packed adventure map complete with a 10-story campaign, side quests, a huge and detailed open-world, boss battles, an in-game currency system, custom voice acting, numerous Easter Eggs, and much more. This map is Chris6d’s 11th map overall.

You don’t need to play the other Torn maps before playing this one, as the lore is explained within this one. All rules and settings, as well as the Resource Pack, will be provided upon loading the map. Every level has been tested numerous times by multiple people and is fully completable. Feel free to download the map and play it for yourself — and you’re welcome to make YouTube videos and walkthroughs of this map!

**Must play in Java 1.21.8 only.** Start at **-72 5 427** if you’re not there already.

A single-player story-based puzzle game that does not require playing the previous two Tempus Mortem games.

An anonymous email sends you on a quest to save your future from grave danger. A mysterious machine makes you think long and hard about your future as an employee in Tempus Industries. Are you up to the challenge?

Tempus Mortem III is a single-player puzzle adventure game inspired by point-and-click adventure games. This is the final game in the Tempus Mortem series. While knowledge of the previous two games would certainly help you appreciate the story and references more, TMIII can be played without any knowledge of those games.

This is the first of the Tempus Mortem games built in Creative, as the previous two were built in survival on Zedcraft, Zedaph's patron server. It makes strong use of command blocks, and thus has some nonstandard mechanics, but does not require any mods or datapacks.

# DESCEND

**DESCEND** is a story-driven psychological Minecraft horror map following John, an ordinary office worker whose recurring nightmares begin to blur with reality.

The folder should be named:

**§7by §aHusseinsAbyss §f§l[§c§l1.21.4§f§l]§r**

### 🔷 Step 3

Launch **Minecraft 1.21.4 OptiFine**.

### 🔷 Step 4

Open **Singleplayer**, select **DESCEND**, and enjoy the experience.

---

Thank you for playing.

readme:
Located somewhere in Britdenec, a world ruled by the gods, is the city of Romia. Something unusual seems to be happening in this town. Will you be able to solve this case after being transported to the town by a mysterious entity?

※ This manual and world were translated using Google Gemini. We apologize if there are any mistakes.

## Version

**For Minecraft Java Edition Ver. 1.21.11 Only**

I do not support other versions.

## Recommended Settings (Optional)

- Number of Players: 1–5 (possible with more, but bosses are tougher, not recommended)

- Brightness: Your preference (brighter is better)

- Main Volume: Audible (do not turn it off)

- Draw Distance: Your preference (tested at 8 chunks, may not work at very low distances)

- Play in a vanilla environment without mods (not designed for mods)

## Difficulty Levels

- **Easy:** Comfortable difficulty for everyone

- **Normal:** Recommended

- **Hard:** Challenging in many ways

- **Very Hard:** For experts

- **Nightmare:** Not intended for completion

Difficulty settings can be changed within the world.

Never set the difficulty level using commands.

## Troubleshooting Q&A

**Q:** Why do I get a warning when I try to enter a world?

**A:** This warning appears because you're tampering with Byme. You can safely ignore it.

**Q:** How do I install a world?

**A:** Please refer to this video: [https://youtu.be/t2xBxEWfj2s](https://youtu.be/t2xBxEWfj2s)

**Q:** Staff? Noble Phantasm? What's this?

**A:** This world has a system of magic, swordsmanship, archery, etc. controlled by commands.

**Q:** Why are there enemies that magic doesn't work on?

**A:** Some mobs resist magic, others resist physical attacks.

**Q:** What's the point of beds?

**A:** Sleeping grants a bonus.

**Q:** The debuff effect doesn't go away when I drink star syrup...

**A:** It will only go away if you drink earth dew.

**Q:** I don't have enough money!

**A:** Try exploring dungeons, talking to NPCs, or fishing.

**Q:** Is ○○ a bug or a feature?

**A:** Please cont11

name: An Amazing Journey: Inner Office Space
readme:
A brand new maze map with 3 mazes built for players of all sizes!

This maze map contains mazes based on concepts I always wanted to bring to life in Minecraft. I made good use of the attribute command to modify the size of the player to properly fit in all the nooks and crannies of these mazes. I had originally started working on this map for release in September of 2024 in order to qualify for a giveaway event but there was too much going on and the scope of the map just got too big so I released it much later.
Consider this the third in the Office trilogy, with the first two being A Bogus Chapter and An Amazing Delivery. I don't know if this map is as good as A Bogus Chapter but it's definitely better than An Amazing Delivery.

Here's what you can expect in this map:

- 3 new mazes in traditional An Amazing Journey format (3x3x3 cell format... give or take)
- Plenty of levers to be pulled and keys to be found in order to reach the goal
- An actual steady supply of dangerous mobs (but not too dangerous)
- Lots of classic video game references
- Runs in 1.21.4 (use earlier or later versions at your own expense)
- Can be completed in about... I don't know, 10 to 40 minutes?
- 5-page manual
- A small resource pack for some story-related fun times

A recent update made the following changes:

- Both lights above the stuffed bear are now off.
- The room with the green platform will not teleport you until the green platform appears.
- A visual was added to the arcade cabinet with a clue on what to do.
- Updated from 1.21.3 to 1.21.4.

Enjoy and let me know what you think!

The map's concept is loosely inspired by the Alice in Wonderland 2010 movie. However, it ended up being completely unrelated to its story, so watching the movie is not necessary at all.

Al and Izz are the two characters the players will portray during this adventure map, in which their observation, puzzle solving and cordination are tested as they travel through the bizarre Wanderland, using their unique skills to complement each other and find their way back home.

This map is not compatible with any other version besides 1.21.4. It operates entirely based on command blocks, so no resource packs or data packs have to be downloaded in order to play it. At least one of the two players has to be able to use commands in order for the map to work properly. A playthrough of the map is roughly 7-8 hours long, but given the fact that it depends entirely on how quickly the puzzles are figured out, that number may vary a lot.

This map was created by Zafiarox and Packi124, and playtested by RouxbixCube, Velocity9000, oSenpqi and Codezoom.

name: The Netherflame Blade
description: Can you forge the legendary Netherflame Blade and defeat a mysterious evil?
readme:
The Netherflame Blade is a singleplayer adventure/puzzle/PVE map for version 1.21.4 EXACTLY that was made by me, [PsyKat777](https://www.youtube.com/@psykat777), the creator of the [Enhanced](https://www.minecraftmaps.com/48395-enhanced) map series. It has been tested by me and 2 beta testers, [guigui0246](https://www.youtube.com/@guigui0246/videos) and [soph1703](https://www.youtube.com/@humungousRat/videos). Based on what I hear from the testers, the map’s puzzles are about normal difficulty, and the combat entirely depends on your in-game difficulty. The testers also tell me that it should take about 2-3 hours to beat. While development was a bit rocky for various reasons, I finished the map over a year after I started developing it!

In it, you are a teenage boy in rural South Carolina, USA, and the day is March 19th, 2017. Due to your poor performance in school as of late, your parents have decided that you will be spending the day outdoors like they did when they were your age. After wandering around for a few hours, you encounter a mysterious man and quickly find yourself deep underground in a ruined laboratory.

In this laboratory, more formally Facility 33 of the Arctangent Laboratories, you will uncover all sorts of secrets, from information regarding a legendary sword called the “Netherflame Blade” to the true nature of the mysterious evil that has destroyed the facility. If you want to leave this place, you’ll have to forge the Netherflame Blade and defeat this evil.

This map tries its best to keep and accentuate what was good about the Enhanced maps (interesting story and lore, charm, etc.) while taking away the bad parts (annoyingly difficult puzzles, excessive dialogue, lack of direction, etc.). New aspects are also added, like voice acting. You do NOT need to have played the Enhanced maps beforehand; they take place in entirely different universes.

The map is inspired by quite a few different things, most notably The Legend of Zelda, [The Kitatcho Laboratories](https://www.minecraftmaps.com/44680-the-kitatcho-laboratories-chapter-1-2020-reboot), and the SCP Foundation. However, it also has some smaller inspirations, like those old NicoThePro tool maps, Undertale/Deltarune, and [Don't Turn It On Origins: Realms](https://www.minecraftmaps.com/49646-don-t-turn-it-on-origins-realms).

So, yeah, hope you enjoy!

name: Underground Mega Maze of Confusion
readme:
The Underground Mega Maze of Confusion is a labyrinth filled with puzzles, mobs, and loot! The goal of the game is to find three levers, the diamond lever, emerald lever, and gold lever, which you can use to work the final puzzle. Upon completing the final puzzle, you will enter a boss battle, so make sure to hold onto any good items you find in the maze! You can play the map solo, or with your friends.

I originally developed this map in 1.14, but I never uploaded it. Recently, I decided I would improve the map, bring it up to date to 1.21.1, and upload it. The map is a combination of a maze, puzzle, and PvE, all tied together in a little adventure. There are chests hidden throughout the maze that contain loot, hints, and keys to help you on your journey. Some puzzles are needed to complete the map, others will only give better loot.

There is a lever puzzle hidden in the maze, but it's missing three levers. Once you find the three levers, place them on the lever puzzle and solve it to exit the maze. But wait! You're not done yet. There is a final boss battle once you exit the maze, so you want to make sure you are preparing yourself throughout your journey.

You should be able to play the map with as many people as you want, the only issue is that there is a limited amount of loot, so the more people that play, the more you're spreading yourself thin loot-wise.

This is my first, and as of now only, map that I created, so it's nothing crazy but I believe it should be fun, especially for those who love puzzles and a good challenge. That being said, I'm always willing to hear feedback, so if you have any, let me know. I hope you enjoy!

name: Five Nights at William's 2: Born to be Scrapped
readme:
Survive 5 nights at the William's Dinofunpark Facility. Uncover Jake's past and defend yourself against your old friends and newly created animatronics. Some can only see, while others can only hear...

## Welcome to William's Dinofunpark Facility

This is the maintenance and holding area for our animatronics, where old models are repaired and restored, and new arrivals like Petey the Allosaurus, Lemmy the Dilophosaurus, and Brian the Parasaur await activation before being shipped to their new homes.

After several weeks of operation, the animatronics at William's Dinofunpark suddenly broke down. They'll remain at the facility for repairs until they're ready to return to the stage, but someone needs to keep an eye on them.

You play as **Jake Mandos**, a man suffering from memory loss — he can't remember what happened, or why he's here. Nights have passed. Where were you? What did you do? What happened to them? Each night brings a fragment of your past. Survive from midnight to 6 AM: five nights, five chances to remember… or to regret.

During your shift, you must make sure no one gets in or out of the facility — but most importantly, don’t let the animatronics notice you. There are no doors to shut… no way to run… only a place to hide. Use the locker if you must. And if that fails… trigger the corruption system; it might be your only chance to survive.

## Five Nights at William's 2: Born to be Scrapped

This is the official remake of *Five Nights at William's 2* (2022), featuring enhanced gameplay, refined visuals, and brand-new content.

## Map Features

- 6 playable nights
- Custom night mode with challenges
- Classic FNaF-style horror gameplay
- AI-controlled animatronics with unique and randomized behavior
- Story-driven minigames and cutscenes

## Enhancements & New Content in the Remake

- New minigames and rare events
- Easy and Hard mode
- Redesigned characters
- Additional rare events
- Improved mechanics and AI
- New camera controls (keyboard and hotbar)

## FAQ

**Q:** Can I play this map in Multiplayer?
**A:** No, the map is singleplayer only.

**Q:** Can I play this map on Bedrock Edition?
**A:** No, this map is only compatible with Java Edition.

**Q:** Do I have to play the map on a specific version?
**A:** Yes, you must play the map on the *suggested version*.
*Note: The suggested version may change with future updates.*

**Q:** I get a "Resource reload failed" message and textures won’t load. How do I fix this?
**A:** This is usually caused by insufficient GPU memory. The resource pack uses many high-resolution textures, so you’ll need a graphics card with enough VRAM.

name: Wii Party Plus
readme:
A redone-recreation of Wii Party in Minecraft, where 2-4 players roll dice on a board game, compete in minigame to earn better dice rolls, and be the first to the top to win the game.

Based on the Nintendo Wii game, Wii Party+ is a 2-4 player board game in the style of Mario Party where players move from start to finish on a board with 80 spaces, and win minigames in between rounds to get better dice rolls. The first player to the end wins.

Along the way are challenges that players must get past, such as a wall requiring a certain minimum dice roll, a spike that could blast you backwards, or multiple different ways to fall into the Volcano. If you fall into the Volcano, you are redirected off the main path to complete this 10-spaces long side path, which you will be placed back to where you were on the main board once out of the Volcano.

There are different types of spaces: blank spaces are the most common, but blue spaces send you forwards, and red spaces send you backwards. Yellow spaces are tornadoes which allow you to knock a player of your choice 5 spaces backwards. Green spaces are 1vAll minigames, where the player who landed on it goes up against the other players and tries to win a minigame against them. If they win, they go up 9 spaces; if they lose, they go back 6 spaces.

There are 33 regular minigames and four 1vAll minigames.

This map is for Minecraft version 1.21.3, NOT 1.21.2 or earlier!

If you spot any bugs, please report them here. Thank you for playing and have fun!
~Chhistenn

name: Mini Goo Bloom
readme:
Wash the goop away from the sunny Isle Medusa. Use your water guns to help save this beautiful island. Inspired by Super Mario Sunshine.

![](https://i.imgur.com/CYg9jvb.png)

## Overview

"Mini Goo Bloom" is an adventure map inspired by "Super Mario Sunshine" with a focus set on

Exploration & PvE

. In this

singleplayer & multiplayer

 map, you will explore the tropical Isle Granchio and help defeat all the goop monster which plague the island. The map is roughly

50 min

 long and features

voice acting

,

custom music, mechanics, models, textures, sounds

 and more. It's a sequel to [Sunny Goo Bloom](project/sunny-goo-bloom-advenure-map/). The map is made

for Minecraft version

1.21.3

 (1.21.4 will not work and will lock the map!) The current version is v2.

Installation

Extract the .zip-archive with a program like 7-zip or WinRAR. Then, add the world file into your saves folder, just like with every other map. The resource pack will install add itself automatically, once you open the world. That's it!

Multiplayer

Everybody needs operator rights

 in order to click on some dialogue options in the chat and run the

/function

 command. The map supports up to 8 players, but will work with an indefinite amount, although this will cause visual glitches with water levels and health bars.

The resource pack is needed for every player

 and is inside the worlds folder and called "resources.zip". Again, it is important to give it to every player.

![](https://i.imgur.com/E9xEykn.png)

Add-on/DLC support

The map supports custom Add-ons. I have made some example ones, to show my community how to develop these. [Click here for a full list of all Add-ons known to me.](project/add-ons-for-mini-goo-bloom/) Just download them and follow the installation instructions, which are usually just putting the datapack into the datapacks folder of the world and running

/reload

Sodium and Optifine Support

The map supports

 [Sodium](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/sodium), as well as [Optifine](https://optifine.net/downloads) for a few additional visual featur

es (Sodium may say that the resource pack is incompatible, but it will work fine.).

If you want to use shaders, I recommend [Sildur's Vibrant Shaders Extreme](https://sildurs-shaders.github.io/downloads/). This is also the shader used for all the screenshots.

A small book about the maps development

Inside the downloaded ZIP-folder, you can find a PDF-document called:

Making of - Mini Goo Bloom

. This small book contains a bit of background information about the map. Things like where I got ideas from and scrapped content. If you enjoy such things, just have a look. None of the information in there is essential to understand the map. I just enjoy making such things :D

Bug Report

If you find anything that looks like it's not working as it should, please leave a comment and I will look into it.

Known Issue:

The rocket thruster can sometimes fail or launch a player very high, if the server tick rate is too fast or too slow (aka server lag is present.).

Despite my best effort, this issue can sometimes occur due to the limitations Minecraft has.

name: Four Corners!
readme:
Your favorite elementary schoolgame from your childhood made in Minecraft! Hide in one of the four corners and hope you aren't caught by the seeker!

## The Popular Elementary School Game in Minecraft!

In Four Corners, made for 2 or more people, a spotter is designated to find as many people as they can! Each round, everyone but the spotter will choose one of four corners: Corner I, II, III, or IV, and whichever corner the spotter chooses, everyone in that corner loses a life! The hiders have 2-3 lives before they are eliminated! The spotter has a certain number of rounds to find & eliminate all the hiders, otherwise the hiders win!

For a fun addition, turn on Obstacles! With them on, random objects & barriers will litter the playing field to make it slightly more challenging & interesting for the hiders to get to their corners!

Map is playable for 1.21.5 only, and requires at least 2 players; there is no maximum number of people (spectators can also join to watch). Please do not play with Lunar Client!!! If you're a Youtuber/Streamer, please give credit to me & leave a download link to this map in the description! That helps me out a lot!
